### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* 8 years of experience designing, constructing, or managing infrastructure projects.
* Experience creating infrastructure designs (e.g., telecom, electrical, mechanical), drawing sets for builds, and remodels of data center networking spaces.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in data center construction, fit\-out and services program.
* Experience managing data center infrastructure and fit out projects.
* Experience in project management, comfort with operating in a high\-paced, changing work environment, and ability to prioritize multiple functions and tasks, manage time efficiently and navigate ambiguity.
* Knowledge of green field civil construction, construction permit and statutory requirements, and local industry standards.
* Working knowledge of finance as applied to project/program management.

**About the job**
-----------------


Our Data Center Delivery and Engineering (DCDE) team is a collection of architectural design experts, mechanical engineers, electrical engineers, construction project managers, water/air specialist, data center services managers, and project controls managers who plan, design, and construct the most efficient data centers in the world.


Our mission is to reliably design and deliver the world’s leading technical infrastructure by building and supporting the operation of safe, fast, affordable, scalable, and sustainable data center capacity to Google.


We are dedicated to fostering a spirit of performance and shared partnership to be the partner of choice to provide needed data center capacity.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work with partners, customers and key stakeholders to develop and articulate plans and long term strategy. Initiate new programs in response to need and be the catalyst for winning support and driving them through the execution phase.
* Manage various programs of work, engage teams and engineers, set the pace for development, deployment and delivery of data center services and infrastructure. Develop and prepare project documentation, process maps, presentations and tracking reports to provide detailed current status of each project.
* Use technical judgment to drive project delivery, technology reviews, challenge proposals and build consensus.
* Analyze services performance and system performance data and translate into recommendations and actionable plans.
* Serve as an escalation point for our external partners and coordinate efforts with all of the internal stakeholders across the globe.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. 295e092b.title: ADF Architect
295e092b.description:
Date live: 08/18/2026


Business Area: Risk Finance and Treasury


Area of Expertise: Technology


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000116017


  
Embark on a transformative journey as an ADF Architect at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.


To be successful in this role as an ADF Architect , you should possess the following skillsets:


* Considerable hands\-on programming experience in Java, Python, .NET, and Unix/Linux shell scripting, developing high\-performance applications, automation frameworks, and scalable data pipelines in enterprise environments
* Deep expertise in Java, Scala, Apache Spark, Amazon S3, Hadoop ecosystem technologies, and cloud\-based big data platforms, with a proven ability to design, develop, and optimize large\-scale data processing solutions
* Experience with the design and implementation of distributed data architectures and ETL/ELT workflows, leveraging Spark, cloud storage, and modern big data technologies to process and analyze high\-volume, high\-velocity datasets
* Proven experience working in highly regulated industries, delivering technology solutions that meet stringent compliance, governance, security, audit, and data privacy requirements
* Effective collaboration with cross\-functional teams including engineering, architecture, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable, and regulatory\-compliant data and application solutions

Desired Skillsets:


* Working knowledge of operating within regulated financial services environments, with experience supporting risk, trading, or regulatory technology functions and navigating complex governance and compliance requirements
* Solid understanding of information security principles, controls, and industry best practices, including secure software development, data protection, access management, and regulatory compliance standards
* Proven ability to work effectively in cross\-functional Agile teams, collaborating with product owners, business analysts, architects, and engineers to deliver high\-quality solutions in iterative development environments
* Ample domain knowledge of market risk and regulatory frameworks, including hands\-on experience with regulations such as FRTB Standardized Approach (SA) and Internal Models Approach (IMA), and an understanding of their implementation within technology platforms
* Deep expertise in at least one major asset class such as Foreign Exchange (FX), Interest Rates (IR), Credit, Equities, or Commodities, with a good understanding of associated products, risk measures, pricing, and trading workflows.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role is based in our Pune office.


**Purpose of the role**


To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.


**Accountabilities**


* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

**Vice President Expectations**


* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

1d774383.title: Senior Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer - India
1d774383.description:
**Company Overview**
 Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
   

  

****Company Operating Rhythm****
 At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
   

  

 Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
   

  

 Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\.
   

  

**Note: this role is based out of India and will service the APAC region.**
**Opportunity**
 Deepgram is expanding across APAC and operating a follow\-the\-sun model. We are hiring a Pre\-Sales Solutions Engineer in India to win complex technical evaluations, design clear solution paths, and drive repeatable adoption for strategic accounts. Our strategic Account Executives do not hand off their customers after the first sale, so you will partner long term across discovery, POC, production launch, and expansion. You will focus on pre\-sales, and you will often step into post\-sales style work when the stakes are high and continuity matters.
   

  

**About Applied Engineering At Deepgram**
 Applied Engineering blends what many companies split into Solutions Engineering, Architecture, Consulting, and Senior Technical Support. We are builders and communicators who bridge sales and engineering. We help customers move from problem to production with speed, clarity, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead technical discovery for strategic opportunities. Map business goals to measurable technical success criteria and an evaluation plan.
* Design, scope, and execute POCs that prove value. Define datasets, metrics, and timelines that land a clear technical win.
* Build lightweight prototypes, sample integrations, and demos using Deepgram SDKs and APIs.
* Advise on architecture for accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost. Cover cloud, self\-hosted, hybrid, and data residency needs.
* Run security and compliance threads common in APAC. Prepare crisp responses for Singapore PDPA, Japan APPI, Korea PIPA, Australia’s Privacy Act, and India’s DPDP Act.
* Triage and debug issues during evaluations. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support to unblock customers quickly.
* Create reusable assets that scale. Turn repeated requests into working samples, reference architectures, runbooks, and field guides.
* Partner with Solutions Architects and Support for seamless continuity after initial wins. Stay involved through expansion phases when needed.
* Enable the field. Collaborate with AEs, CSMs, and partners on positioning, demos, and technical validation for priority use cases.


**Regional Expectations**
* Based in an APAC time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours across East Asia, Southeast Asia, and ANZ.
* Excellent written and spoken English. Additional Asian languages are a strong plus, especially Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, or Hindi.
* Familiarity with procurement, InfoSec, and data privacy expectations across APAC.
* Ability to travel within the region for key customer milestones. Estimated travel 10 to 20 percent.


**Your First 90 Days**
**Ramp approach for this role** 
 Ramping mirrors the Solutions Architect plan, with explicit ticket work and earlier support for strategic Account Executives. In the first weeks you will pick up low\-risk customer tickets to learn our systems and support flow, then progress to pre\-sales escalations tied to active evaluations.
   

  

**First 30 days**
* Ramp on Deepgram’s product surface area, platform APIs, SDKs, evaluation methodology, and security review materials.
* Shadow strategic discovery and POC calls across APAC time zones.
* Triage and resolve low\-risk tickets with a Solutions Architect or Support partner. Focus on reproductions, log and trace collection, SDK setup issues, and clear notes and handoffs.
* Publish one internal field guide that clarifies a common APAC pre\-sales topic (for example data residency, telephony capture, or evaluation metrics).


**By day 60**
* Own two evaluations end to end with defined success criteria and timelines.
* Serve as the named technical partner for one or two strategic AEs. Run weekly technical deal reviews and prepare objection\-handling packs.
* Take point on higher\-signal tickets related to your evaluations, coordinating fast fixes with Product, Engineering, and Support.
* Deliver one live demo that becomes a reusable asset for the region. Pair with a Solutions Architect on a production launch to learn handoffs and escalation paths.


**By day 90**
* Act as the primary pre\-sales technical owner for several opportunities and expansions within strategic accounts.
* Close at least one complex technical win with a measurable impact on revenue.
* Lead one customer architecture workshop that documents a reference plan for production rollout or expansion.
* Convert repeated ticket patterns into a runbook, sample, or accelerator and present a short readout on the impact.


**You Will Thrive Here If You**
* Enjoy the mix of customer conversations and hands\-on building.
* Can move from whiteboard to working code and back without losing the thread.
* Communicate clearly with executives and deeply with engineers.
* Value speed with rigor and crisp documentation.
* Like winning together across regions and functions.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5 or more years in Solutions Engineering or a similar customer\-facing technical role focused on pre\-sales.
* Professional software engineering experience in at least one language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Rust. You can build POCs and tools that real users run.
* Hands\-on experience with modern cloud platforms. Comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes, networking fundamentals, and secure API design.
* Proven track record leading POCs for enterprise customers and earning the technical win.
* Clear written and verbal communication across both technical and executive audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with speech recognition, TTS, voice quality analysis, or AI agents that orchestrate LLMs.
* Familiarity with telephony and real\-time media concepts such as SIP, WebRTC, streaming, and WebSocket integrations.
* Experience with self\-hosted and hybrid deployments, including Helm\-based installs and production observability.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and data residency topics that appear in APAC enterprise reviews.
* Fluency in an additional Asian language such as Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, or Hindi.


**How We Work**
* Remote across APAC with periodic regional meetups.
* Close partnership with AEs, SAs, Product, and Engineering to support continuous coverage across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.
* Shared playbooks, defined escalation paths, and measurable SLAs.


**Interview Process**
* Recruiter screen focused on experience, motivations, and logistics.
* Hiring manager conversation focused on technical depth and customer impact.
* Practical assessment that mirrors real work. Expect discovery, solution design, and a short hands\-on exercise.
* Panel interviews with cross\-functional partners.
* Live demo and architecture walkthrough of a past technical win. Show your approach to success criteria, trade offs, and outcomes.


 If this sounds like you, we would love to meet you!
   

  

***Notice** 
 : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @* 
*deepgram.com* 
*email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.*

243e94f6.description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------


We are seeking a skilled System Expert, Managed Services to provide advanced technical leadership across telecom network operations, managed services, automation, cloud transformation and core network platforms. The role is based in Bangalore, India, within Managed Services, reporting to the NOC Operations Manager.
The individual will act as a technical reference point for teams supporting live IT and telecommunications systems, including activities related to data build configuration, software rollout, support integration, third\-line technical support, troubleshooting, vendor escalation, automation and operational optimisation.
This role supports telecom operators, including Vodafone operating companies, joint ventures and external customers, ensuring data loading, service restoration, incident handling and network recovery activities are completed in line with agreed procedures, SLAs and KPIs.**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Provide expert technical support for live IT and telecommunications systems across managed services operations.
* Perform data build configuration, software rollout and support integration activities requested by planning and delivery teams.
* Act as a technical reference point for coding, troubleshooting, operational processes and best practice adoption across engineering teams.
* Develop, implement, modify, test and harmonise software and hardware solutions within information systems and telecom applications.
* Lead the design and architecture of complex multi\-domain technical solutions aligned with business strategy and critical business functions
* Drive research and development initiatives from concept to implementation, with a focus on automation, emerging technologies and long\-term operational value.
* Investigate and resolve highly complex technical issues received from NOC, COPS and SAC teams using programming, debugging and telecom\-specific methods.
* Lead root cause analysis, incident resolution, defect tracking, service restoration and performance improvement activities.
* Escalate technical issues to vendors and collaborate with internal teams to support rapid issue resolution and service continuity.
* Design, implement and maintain automation and robotic process solutions to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual work and enhance customer experience.
* Support business continuity planning, disaster recovery and special event network readiness activities.
* Maintain network documentation, including HLDs, LLDs and operational procedures, in line with network development and technology updates.
* Mentor engineering teams, share technical knowledge and support technical training to strengthen capabilities across deployment and operations.
**Who you are**
---------------


* You have a BTech or BE degree in Electronics or Telecommunications.
* You bring 11 to 16 years of experience in the telecommunications industry.
* You have technical leadership experience across Ericsson IMS, VoLTE, VoWiFi, VoNR, SMS over IMS, RCS, CS Core, EPC and 5G Core domains.
* You can lead architecture, design governance and roadmap evolution for voice, messaging, roaming, interconnect and next\-generation communication services.
* You can lead complex troubleshooting, multi\-vendor interoperability investigations, signalling design reviews and root cause analysis for critical service incidents
* You have experience providing technical oversight for Ericsson, Nokia and Oracle SBC platforms across IMS, EPC and Core Network domains.
* You understand HLDs, LLDs, vendor solutions, acceptance testing and transformation programmes.
* You have experience with cloud and network transformation technologies such as VMware, OpenStack, NFV, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, CI/CD, automation, Python, Ansible, REST APIs and Infrastructure as Code. You can manage service KPIs including VoLTE Registration Success Rate, CSSR, Call Drop Rate, Service Accessibility, Service Retainability, RTP Quality, Capacity Planning and Scalability Management.
* You understand security practices covering IMS security, SBC security, SIP attack mitigation, fraud prevention, secure signalling and regulatory compliance.
* You have experience in vendor governance, performance improvement, operational excellence, technology modernisation and cross\-functional collaboration.

**Desirable experience*** Multi\-vendor Core product experience.
* Experience working on large installations using independent judgement and initiative.
* Knowledge of object\-oriented programming languages such as Java, C\+\+ or Python
* Knowledge of scripting, command line usage and operating system administration across Windows and Unix.
* Knowledge of cloud fundamentals.
* Strong knowledge of robotic process automation software and tools.
* Ability to support team leadership responsibilities when required in urgent circumstances.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to work on complex managed services operations across live telecom infrastructure and customer\-impacting services.
* Exposure to large\-scale core network, IMS, VoLTE, VoWiFi, VoNR, EPC and 5G Core domains.
* Scope to influence architecture, design governance, automation, transformation programmes and service reliability improvements.
* Collaboration with vendors, technical teams and senior stakeholders on critical incidents, service restoration and technology modernisation.
* Opportunity to mentor engineering teams and contribute to knowledge sharing, technical capability building and operational excellence.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across multi\-vendor telecom and core network environments.
* Practical application of automation, robotic process methods, Python, Ansible, REST APIs and Infrastructure as Code in telecom operations.
* Architecture and design governance for IMS, VoLTE, VoWiFi, VoNR, roaming, interconnect and 5G Core services.
* Business continuity, disaster recovery, contingency planning and major incident coordination for critical network services
* Vendor governance, stakeholder communication, operational reporting and service performance improvement.
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------



Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

847e258c.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Technical Program Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 Are you a technical program manager who wants to shape the cloud platform for Mastercard’s products? Do you want to work for a company that offers above and beyond benefits including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and even volunteer incentives? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your own professional learning and development?
   

  

 ROLE
   

  

 We are breaking up our monoliths and re\-platforming features into re\-usable micro\-services and APIs while we continue to innovate and deliver results for our customers. All net new capabilities will be built on the cloud platform supporting multi\-tenancy and multi\-geography capabilities for the company. We are looking for experienced technical program management professionals to join our team and help us build towards the future. Our Technical Program Managers (TPM) conceptualize, rationalize, and drive multiple simultaneous projects to deliver engineering work across the portfolio in our scrum execution model. In this role, you get to dive as deep as you want into the tech stack, the integration patterns, the organizational capabilities, and the company wide assets that can be leveraged to provide technical solutions to customer problems. You will contribute to the strategies, design choices, and even the cloud infrastructure necessary to build comprehensive believable and achievable execution plans to deliver high\-profile new features and capabilities for our customers. You may drive the execution of a feature through the full stack or may drive a project which spans multiple teams and integrations, reporting meaningful status along the way.
   

  

**All About You**
 Demonstrated ability to operate with independence and autonomy
   

  

 Experience defining and building cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale with a deep understanding of those platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
   

  

 Experience working on programs to define and build cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale
   

  

 Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
   

  

 Proven track record of data driven decision\-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
   

  

 Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
   

  

 Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity
   

  

 Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
   

  

 Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model
   

  

 BS in engineering, computer science or related discipline.
   

  

 Technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software
   

  

 Exposure to building AI Agents for accelerating TPM Efficiency
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

4338eb7e.title: Lead - Presales
4338eb7e.description:
**About Leadsquared**
 LeadSquared is one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in the CRM space — trusted by 2,000\+ customers and 2\.5 lakh\+ users globally. We help organizations automate sales and marketing to run high\-velocity revenue operations at scale. With a strong presence across the US, Middle East, ASEAN, ANZ, and South Africa, LeadSquared is expanding its US vertical teams to drive growth in Education and Healthcare — two of our strongest market segments.
   

  

**About The Role**
 LeadSquared is expanding its US Education vertical and is looking for a senior PreSales Consultant with deep expertise in the Education sector to drive enterprise deal pursuits across Higher Education institutions, K\-12 districts, EdTech platforms, and Workforce Training organizations. You will serve as the technical and solutions authority in the sales process — owning discovery, demo design, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept development — while acting as a trusted advisor to prospects and a strategic partner to the US Sales team.
   

  

***🎓 This is not a generic SE role. We need someone who speaks Education — who understands enrollment funnels, student lifecycle management, and how institutions buy technology.***
**Solution Engineering** 
**Product Demonstrations** 
**RFP/RFI Response** 
**CRM** 
**EdTech** 
**Higher Education** 
**POC Development**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design \& Demonstrations**
* Lead tailored product demonstrations of LeadSquared’s CRM and Student Lifecycle Management platform for Higher Education, K\-12, and EdTech prospects.
* Design and deliver discovery\-led demos that address specific institutional pain points — enrollment management, student engagement, retention, and alumni relations.
* Develop and present end\-to\-end solution blueprints aligned to each prospect’s administrative, enrollment, and technology workflows.
* Build and deliver proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) for complex or competitive enterprise evaluations.
* Showcase integration capabilities with SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool), LMS tools, and other education ecosystem technologies.


**RFP Leadership \& Proposal Excellence**
* Own RFI/RFP responses for US Education prospects, including functional requirements, solution architecture, and integration approach.
* Create compelling solution documents, executive summaries, and business case narratives tailored to CIO, VP Enrollment, and Provost\-level audiences.
* Develop effort estimation, implementation roadmap, and TCO analysis for enterprise Education deployments.
* Maintain and improve a library of standard RFP responses, demo scripts, and proposal templates for the US Education team.


**Education Domain Authority**
* Serve as LeadSquared’s internal subject\-matter expert on US Education: enrollment management, student success, financial aid workflows, and alumni engagement.
* Maintain competitive intelligence across EdTech CRM platforms (Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Ellucian CRM, Element451\) and develop battle cards.
* Stay current on FERPA compliance, Title IV regulations, and accreditation\-related technology requirements.
* Represent LeadSquared at US Education conferences, events, and industry forums to build brand presence and generate pipeline.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Engage VP Enrollment Management, CIOs, Registrars, Student Success Directors, and Provosts as a trusted advisor, not just a vendor.
* Partner with the US Sales team, Marketing, and Customer Success to build winning deal strategies and seamless customer handoffs.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on US Education market requirements and competitive gaps.
* Mentor and support junior PreSales resources as the Education vertical scales.


**What We’re Looking For**
**Experience \& Education**
* 5\-10 years of experience in PreSales, Solution Engineering, or Sales Consulting, with significant tenure supporting US Education accounts.
* Deep understanding of US Higher Education and/or K\-12 institutional buying processes, IT governance, and technology procurement.
* Prior hands\-on experience with EdTech CRM, SIS, or Student Lifecycle Management platforms is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or prior experience working inside a US educational institution is a strong plus.
* Excellent English communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with proven ability to engage C\-suite and VP\-level academic leaders.


**Technical \& Domain Skills**
* Strong understanding of enrollment management, student lifecycle, financial aid, and alumni engagement workflows.
* Familiarity with US Education technology ecosystem: SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool, Infinite Campus), LMS (Canvas, Blackboard, D2L), and communication tools.
* Knowledge of FERPA, data privacy standards, and compliance requirements for US Education technology.
* Proficiency in solution architecture, integration design, and API\-based connectivity for enterprise Education environments.
* Experience with competitive platforms: Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Element451, Ellucian CRM, or similar.


**Good to Have**
* Experience presenting at EDUCAUSE, NACAC, or similar US Education conferences.
* Familiarity with Title IV, accreditation body requirements, and financial aid system integrations.
* Experience with data analytics and reporting for student outcome tracking.

That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a member of our Solution Consulting team, you will have a major impact on our future success by supporting \[Employee Experience, Customer Workflow, ITX] Solution Sales. You will guide revenue for one of our products with the support and partnership of Sales, Product Management, and the executive team. This is a hands\-on technical consultant who can go wide and deep on solution delivery and solution positioning during sales cycles.
   

  

**What You Get To Do In This Role**
 The Solution Consultant is a technical consultant with the advanced ability to develop, position and provide product\-specific solutions during sales cycles while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.
   

  

* Support product sales as a technical and domain expert of a client\-facing BFSI sales team
* Lead discovery workshops to determine customers' challenges and give product demonstrations to align our solution with customer needs
* Answer product feature and technical questions from customers, channel partners and ServiceNow colleagues
* Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value
* Share and learn best practices and re\-usable assets with other Solution Consultants to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
* Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
* Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows


**Qualifications**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 10\+ years of pre\-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience managing BFSI customer.
* Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or technical expertise with cloud software solutions
* Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services
* Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales counterpart to guide execution excellence
* Travel, as necessary

4f2d3dff.title: Enterprise Solutions Manager
4f2d3dff.description:
**The Role:**
 11:11 Systems is looking for a dynamic and experienced Enterprise Solutions Manager (ESM) who will lead and manage technical service delivery on large \& complex accounts. You will direct the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of 11:11 Systems’ solutions, leading a support team comprised of subject matter experts from multiple platforms, operating systems, storage and network technologies. As a trusted advisor, you will provide strategic business and technology support/counsel to your customer across both their production and recovery environments.
   

  

 As ESM, you will be responsible for relationship development and management across key internal and customer stakeholders and executives to help translate their business needs into action.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Document and understand the customer’s current, future / desired state, business goals and challenges, capabilities, and IT investments.
* Based on this understanding provide technical and strategic direction from initial solution design to steady state, based on industry and 11:11 Systems best practices.
* Serve as the single point of ownership for technology solutions and coordinate resources globally to optimize customer and 11:11 Systems value.
* Implement and manage effective governance practices and procedures across contracted scope of responsibilities (including change, incident, request, event, problem, and vendor management).
* Develop highly productive customer relationships and become a Trusted Advisor by providing thought leadership to help shape and grow our value to the customer.
* Direct lifecycle management (LCM) activities to maintain up to date technical documentation, including production \& recovery configurations, application dependency maps, run books and procedures, patching schedules, overall solution architecture document, recovery strategies / plans and contract changes.
* Develop recovery strategies to meet customer RTO/RPO and conduct periodic testing to document recoverability
* Manage service / relationship risk areas and takes steps to mitigate.
* Contribute to securing renewals for expiring contracts by documenting and articulating our value to the customer.
* Participate in engineering efforts required to develop new capabilities to meet customer requirements, document results and sample deliverables.
* Identify sales opportunities and collaborate with Account Executives to grow revenue.
* Process customer self\-service sales requests when needed.
* Meet/Exceed SLA targets by driving service management disciplines around incident, change, and problem management.
* Develop content and effectively lead Monthly Service Reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other strategic client meetings requested by the customer.
* Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values.
* Responsibly receive, transmit, and handle company data and information per Company data handling agreements, work procedures and policies.
* Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements.
* Additional duties as assigned.


**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of professional IT experience with at least 3 years of demonstrated experience related to Enterprise focused TAM role, Solution Architecture and Customer facing Service delivery experience within complex environments.
* Technology certifications preferred, such as MCSE, CCIE, RHCE, VCP, CCDP, Cloud etc.
* At least one professional certification (eg. ITILv3, TOGAF, PRINCE2 etc.), or equivalent demonstrable skills and experience.
* Windows Server.
* Virtualization; including VMWare \& Hyper\-Vs.
* Networking; including routing and switching, security, and firewalls.
* Storage \& backup services/administration.
* Database; Understanding of data models and data flows in complex multitier database and application environments.
* Unix/Linux.
* BCP \& DR scenarios/solutions.
* Knowledge of Multi\-Tier Application architecture design.
* Strong interpersonal skills, customer service skills and communication skills.
* Problem\-solving skills to be able to resolve technical issues.
* Ability to train customers to use systems and software.
* Must be legally eligible to work without visa sponsorship.

The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* India Pension Scheme

4b95dc3e.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking an experienced **Delivery Manager – GCP Cloud** to lead large\-scale cloud transformation, migration, and modernization programs, driving end\-to\-end delivery across cross\-functional teams while managing senior stakeholder relationships and ensuring successful business outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Own end\-to\-end programme delivery across discovery, assessment, landing\-zone readiness, wave planning, migration execution, cutover, warranty, and transition to operations, with overall responsibility for Project/People/Account Management
* Lead multiple cross\-functional and distributed teams; manage scope, schedules, budgets, staffing, dependencies, risks, issues, and executive governance, with awareness of Data Privacy, Security, IP \& Responsible AI activities
* Review solution architectures and migration strategies; validate application dependency maps, migration waves, security, resilience, performance, operability, and cost assumptions
* Chair migration readiness and technical governance forums such as ARB, WAR etc.; lead Go/No\-Go decisions, coordinate cutover, rollback, business validation, warranty, and service acceptance
* Partner with client business, security, infrastructure, application, data, and operations leaders to translate technical constraints into clear business impacts and decisions
* Establish delivery metrics including migration throughput, schedule variance, defect leakage, cutover success, availability, performance, cloud spend, and benefits realization
* Drive adoption of cloud governance and FinOps practices, including policy, tagging, cost allocation, budget controls, rightsizing, and optimization backlogs
* Support presales, estimates, solution shaping, delivery assurance, account growth, and capability development; coach delivery managers and technical leads
* Use approved enterprise GenAI tools responsibly to improve planning, reporting, risk analysis, knowledge management, and stakeholder communication while protecting data and intellectual property

**Requirements**

* 9 to 14 years of experience in IT delivery, including 5\+ years leading large cloud transformation, application modernization, infrastructure, or migration programmes, along with experience managing multiple workstreams, senior stakeholders, and program execution using Agile \& Hybrid methodologies
* Knowledge of GCP resource hierarchy (organizations, folders, projects), IAM, VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, Cloud KMS, and backup/DR concepts
* Familiarity with migration strategy patterns such as rehost, replatform, and refactor
* Ability to govern identity, network segmentation, key management, logging, vulnerability remediation, backup/DR, business continuity, and regulatory requirements
* Expertise in RAID management, financial governance, change control, and executive reporting
* Working knowledge of project tracking systems (Jira/Confluence/ADO/Project) and usage of Gen AI tools for Delivery Management
* Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), containers/Kubernetes (GKE), APIs, integration patterns, and SRE/observability fundamentals
* Ability to facilitate architecture reviews and explain technical trade\-offs, costs, risks, and migration decisions to business and engineering audiences

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Google Cloud Architecture Framework, Cloud Foundation Toolkit, landing\-zone/foundation programmes, and Google Cloud migration methodologies
* Google Cloud certification: Google Cloud Digital Leader, Professional Cloud Architect or equivalent
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, ITIL, or equivalent programme\-management certifications

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

* Have I successfully led large\-scale Oracle database modernization or migration projects involving RAC, Exadata, Autonomous Database, or Data Guard?
* Do I have the technical leadership, customer consulting, and executive communication skills required to influence architecture decisions within highly regulated financial institutions?


**Responsibilities**

27fa6cc6.title: Integration Architect
27fa6cc6.description:
**Job Description**
**About TI**
 Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job!
   

  

**About The Job**
 Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a detailed and results\-oriented leader to become a part of our global Information Technology team as Integration Architect.
   

  

 Sales, Marketing \& Workforce Solutions (SMWS) is critical to the success and growth of TI as a company. Our mission in SMWS is to deliver a best\-in\-class and technically credible digital experience at all stages of the customer lifecycle, scale digital selling to the mass market, and accelerate sales and marketing through digitization and personalization.
   

  

 As an Integration Architect within the Digital Experience Solutions (DES) group, you will be technical leader, responsible for architecting end‑to‑end digital‑experience platforms within Texas Instruments’ IT Solutions organization in India. This is a
 **hands\-on architecture leadership role** 
 and will ensure architectureis
 **secure, scalable, well\-modeled, interoperable, and fit for both operational and analytical use** 
 , while enabling domain teams to deliver independently.
   

  

 The Integration Architect influences through
 **technical authority, standards, and partnership** 
 , working closely with domain engineering teams, platform teams, analytics, and security.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring in well\-rounded expertise around software development, including industry awareness of web technologies, frameworks, secure and scalable architecture, and back\-end services. Sharp focus on execution, organization, and efficiency is critical for this role, including decision making around strategic staffing, cost, and skills. The ability to develop and drive technical strategy and lead effectively cross\-functionally is critical.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Define Solution Architecture – Design, develop and deployment diagrams for all new digital‑experience initiatives
* Technology Strategy \& Roadmap – Evaluate emerging technologies (AI/ML services, edge, serverless)
* Standards \& Governance – Establish coding standards, security baselines, CI/CD and observability best practices
* Proof‑of‑Concept (PoC) Leadership – Lead rapid PoCs to validate architectural choices and capture performance metrics.
* Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management – Partner with product owners, UX designers, data engineers, security, and SRE teams across global TI to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Mentorship \& Knowledge Transfer – Conduct architecture workshops, design‑review sessions, and code‑review guidance for development
* Risk \& Compliance Management – Identify architectural risks (security, performance, vendor lock‑in) and ensure designs meet internal audit requirements.
* Documentation \& Communication – Produce high‑quality architecture artifacts, runbooks, and executive‑level presentations for business partners.
* Continuous Improvement – Track key metrics (lead time, MTTR, MTTD, defect density) and drive process enhancements within the digital‑experience delivery pipeline.
* Build a positive and inclusive work environment with transparency, collaboration, and accountability
* Effectively partner with org and cross\-org leaders to strategically drive successful results
* Identify and resolve problems with urgency and proactively solve issues ahead of time
* Ensure ongoing compliance with IT Security policies and procedures and leverage data\-driven decision\-making


**Qualifications**
**Minimum requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* 6 \+ years of software development, with at least 4 years in Integration/Enterprise architecture.
* Strong experience working with Web technologies (like Spring, Angular, React, NodeJS), Microservices, Kubernetes, NoSQL DB like Mongo and, authentication methods like OAuth and SAML.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder‑management, proven mentorship/leadership, analytical mindset, ability to thrive in an agile environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certification on public cloud platforms and/or architectural frameworks like TOGAF
* Experience in institutionalizing best practices around performance tuning, accessibility, Observability and SEO at enterprise scale.
* Technical acumen on CI/CD pipelines and blue/green deployment strategies on\-prem and/or in public cloud environment.
* Working experience with building integrated and automated solution leveraging Gen AII with RAG and/or MCP offering contextual, personalized experiences and outcomes to achieve business outcome.
* Strong track record of implementing best practices and modern technologies to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable digital solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Ability to manage and prioritize a high number of concurrent tasks, while mentoring team members and partnering cross\-functionally
* Demonstrated success in building and scaling high\-performing, engaged engineering teams.
* Ability to take initiative, drive for results, and be adaptable to change
* Strong time management and prioritization skills to drive strong execution
* Ability to work effectively in an interrupt\-driven, fast\-paced and rapidly changing environment
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships and manage multiple business partner expectations
* Proven experience influencing opinions and gaining consensus
* Possess curiosity, high energy, and helpful attitude to develop a positive team culture
* Ability to present and get buy\-in with technical and non\-technical audiences alike


**About Us**
**Why TI?**
* Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics.
* We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
* Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well\-being is important to us. Please find our country\-specific benefits here


**About Texas Instruments**
 Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com .
   

  

 Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment.
   

  

 If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.
   

  

**About The Team**
 TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship, immigration status or national origin. However, if TI determines that information access or export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit you from working in this position without first obtaining an export license, TI expressly reserves the right not to seek such a license for you and either offer you a different position that does not require an export license or decline to move forward with your employment.

cac5ba08.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
cac5ba08.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5\+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross\-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5\+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi\-workstream delivery programs ($5M\+/year in professional services revenue) end\-to\-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders
* cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect \- Associate
* Experience creating and implementing large\-scale programs
* MBA, or 6\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* 3\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 RSM US India (USI) supports RSM US LLP’s Risk Consulting, Transaction Advisory, Technical Accounting, Financial Consulting, Technology and Management Consulting, Tax, and Assurance practices by providing access to highly skilled professionals for scalable and repeatable business processes across an extended business day. **Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement – Functional Manager**
 RSM’s Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Dynamics 365 CE) practice is a team of highly specialized, multi\-disciplinary professionals delivering innovative Microsoft business application solutions for global clients.
   

  

 RSM is seeking a
 **Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) Functional Manager** 
 who blends deep, hands\-on configuration and customization experience with the leadership skills to run multiple concurrent engagements. The ideal candidate brings end\-to\-end mastery of the Dynamics 365 CE suite and the Microsoft Power Platform, sound solution architecture judgment, strong client presence, and a passion for growing the next generation of consultants. * Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop junior consultants and grow high\-performing teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong executive presence

465361af.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
465361af.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Technical Program Manager Role Overview
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe our differences enable us to be a better team — one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.
   

  

 Technology at Mastercard
   

  

 What we create today will define tomorrow: revolutionary technologies that reshape the digital economy to be more connected and inclusive than ever before — safer, faster, and more sustainable.
   

  

 We need technologists who are energized by the challenges of a truly global network, with the talent and vision to create the critical systems and products that power global commerce and connect people everywhere to the vital goods and services they need every day.
   

  

 Working at Mastercard means being part of a unique culture that is inclusive, diverse, and built on collaboration. It is a place that celebrates your strengths, values your experiences, and offers the flexibility to shape a career across disciplines and continents — while working alongside experts and leaders at every level of the business to improve what exists and invent what’s next.
   

  

**All About You**
 Are you a technical program manager who wants to work for a company that offers above\-and\-beyond benefits, including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and volunteer incentives?
   

  

 Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your professional learning and development?
   

  

 The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.
   

  

 Knowledge / Experience
   

  

* 8\+ years leading large\-scale, end\-to\-end technical programs across multiple teams with complex dependencies in enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in portfolio\- and initiative\-level program management, including governance, execution tracking, reporting, and operational readiness.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile Scrum, SAFe, and blended delivery models, with strengths in work decomposition, sprint planning, backlog management, and delivery acceleration.
* Solid understanding of software engineering, system design, and architecture, with the ability to engage engineers on trade\-offs, scalability, and constraints.
* Proven ability to drive business and customer outcomes through technical execution, measured through metrics and results.
* Demonstrated strength in risk management, ambiguity handling, stakeholder influence, and executive communication.
* Experience building and leading TPM organizations, mentoring leaders, shaping practices, and influencing technology roadmaps.


**About The Role**
* Drive transformational change in end\-to\-end product delivery by applying technical program management and engineering best practices across agile and hybrid environments.
* Lead large enterprise technical programs and products from inception to delivery, operating autonomously in ambiguous problem spaces.
* Maintain a deep understanding of business domains, systems, and architectural decisions, translating complexity into clarity and execution.
* Provide thought leadership, drive problem decomposition, accelerate delivery, and ensure predictable outcomes under tight deadlines.
* Establish trusted partnerships with engineering, business, and executive stakeholders, influencing decisions and aligning execution.
* Build, lead, and mature a high\-performing TPM function, fostering strong delivery culture, empathy, and accountability.


 Major Accountabilities
   

  

* Own program and portfolio execution, optimizing processes, aligning teams and technologies, and ensuring efficient use of resources.
* Drive delivery from planning through production, proactively managing risks, dependencies, escalations, and blockers.
* Establish clear governance, metrics, and reporting to enable transparency, timely decisions, and continuous improvement.
* Foster cross\-team collaboration, accountability for results, and organizational learning.
* Act as the primary program representative, providing clear communication, accurate status, and stakeholder alignment.
* Stay current on technology trends, evaluate designs, and influence long\-term organizational and technical direction.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

f4c327fe.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
f4c327fe.description:
**Location Details:** 
 Remote, India
 



  





 At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full\-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.
 



  





 This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.
 



  





**Join Our Team...** 




  





 This role is for a
 
 Staff Technical Program Manager within GoDaddy’s engineering organization, focused on building scalable, fault\-tolerant systems that power critical customer and platform experiences at massive scale.
 



  





 GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing all of the help and tools to succeed online. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights and the people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success!
 



  





**What you'll get to do...** 




  





 As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will be at the forefront of our project management efforts. You will coordinate the seamless delivery of technical programs, ensuring our projects are successfully implemented and meet the highest standards. Your role is pivotal in driving our mission forward by:
 


* Leading and coordinating multiple workstreams across product engineering, legal, and enterprise customer commitments.
* Owning the program layer of cloud environment security efforts, including control rollout, remediation SLAs, and audit readiness.
* Building mechanisms for seamless execution such as product\-style intake, prioritization frameworks, and launch readiness reviews.
* Partnering closely with product management, build, and engineering leadership to ensure successful project launches and smooth deprecation of prior tooling.
* Holding your own in architecture reviews, build documents, and post\-incident debriefs, while reading and reasoning about production code in modern languages (Python, Go, Java, etc.).
* Reasoning about cloud infrastructure at the architecture level, particularly with AWS, to ensure robust security measures.
* Directly reading metrics, logs, and dashboards, querying SIEM data, and interpreting SLO burn to maintain high standards of security and performance.



  





**Your experience should include...** 




  





 To succeed in this role, you should have a proven history of outstanding performance and experience in the following areas:
 


* 10\+ years of technical program management, with at least 5 years in security, cloud, data platform, or infrastructure organizations at scale.
* Prior individual contributor (IC) engineering experience, particularly in software, security, data, or SRE, or comparable background.
* Direct ownership of programs spanning multiple engineering teams, with reporting to Director\-level or higher.
