14e02865.title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
14e02865.description:
**About Signant Health**
 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
   

  

 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a member of Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy and manage infrastructure, application components and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable and sustainable. You will also work with Apps Integration and the DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall Support Process.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Automation for tasks like deployment of servers and application software across environment, alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work\-arounds and resolution of reported issues
* Quickly \& effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve troubleshooting process in the long run
* Ensure the stability and availability of Application operation components running on Public Clouds.
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotation to support production environments and shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right\-size servers and services
* Migrate on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* BS degree in Computer Science or related discipline
* At least 3 years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices. Hands on experience with DevOps Tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, TFS
* Experience with cloud platforms like AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, PowerShell
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
* Hands\-on experience in Linux/Windows server operating systems, and Web Server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere and Apache Web Server
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres or MySQL
* Proven ability to work in a team\-oriented environment, providing back\-up support to team members \& establishing/maintaining effective work relationships with co\-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.


**Desired Qualifications**
* 5\+ years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices
* Experience migrating on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation and shift work to support production environments
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need base


**Why Signant Health?**
 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
   

  

 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
   

  

 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
   

  

 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
   

  

 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

a82959d6.title: Specialist - Presales
a82959d6.description:
**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a skilled
 **Fortinet Pre\-Sales Engineer \& Product Technical Specialist** 
 to support our
 **distribution business** 
 . The role focuses on
 **technical pre\-sales** 
 ,
 **partner enablement** 
 , and
 **customer engagement** 
 across the
 **Fortinet portfolio** 
 .
   

  

 The candidate will work closely with
 **distribution\-managed partners, system integrators, and enterprise customers** 
 , providing technical expertise, solution design support, and enablement to drive Fortinet adoption and growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Pre\-Sales \& Solution Engineering**
* Act as a technical SME for the Fortinet security portfolio, including:
+ FortiGate (NGFW)
+ FortiManager / FortiAnalyzer
+ FortiSwitch \& FortiAP
+ FortiEDR, FortiClient, FortiSIEM (as applicable)

* Support pre\-sales activities such as:
+ Requirement gathering and technical discovery
+ Solution architecture and design
+ Technical presentations, demos, and POCs

* Assist sales teams with:
+ RFP/RFI responses
+ BOM creation and solution size
+ Licensing and subscription guidance


**Partner \& Customer Engagement**
* Participate in:
+ Distribution Managed Partner Round Tables
+ Partner Round Tables
+ Customer Round Tables

* Engage directly with partners and customers to position Fortinet solutions effectively.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor during the sales lifecycle.


**Training, Enablement \& Onboarding**
* Deliver partner enablement and training sessions on Fortinet solutions.
* Support new partner onboarding, ensuring technical readiness and alignment with Fortinet best practices.
* Conduct Fast Track trainings and technical workshops.
* Help partners prepare for and achieve Fortinet NSE certifications.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, demo labs, and enablement material.


**Collaboration \& Vendor Interaction**
* Work closely with:
+ Internal sales and product teams
+ Fortinet vendor technical and channel teams

* Stay updated with Fortinet product roadmap, new releases, and security trends.
* Provide feedback from partners and customers to improve GTM and enablement strategy.


**Technical Skills**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Fortinet security solutions, especially FortiGate.
* Solid understanding of:
+ Network security concepts (Firewall, VPN, IPS, Web Filtering)
+ SD\-WAN and Secure Networking
+ Endpoint and access security (basic to intermediate)

* Knowledge of:
+ Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, switching)
+ Linux basics
+ Cloud security (AWS / Azure / GCP) – preferred


**Certifications (Mandatory / Preferred)**
* Fortinet NSE 1 – NSE 7 (at least NSE 4/5 preferred)
* Fortinet Fast Track certification
* Higher NSE levels are a strong advantage.


**Professional Skills**
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex security concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working in a distribution or channel\-driven environment.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and comfortable handling multiple partners.


**Experience Requirements**
* 3 – 5 years of experience in:
+ Pre\-sales engineering
+ Network/security consulting
+ Technical specialist or solution engineering roles

* Prior experience with network security or firewall technologies is mandatory.

f0705a90.title: BTI Architect Ethernet - Offshore

**Overview:**  

As a Senior Solution Architect within the BT Solution Architecture team, you will serve as the trusted technical authority for BT’s enterprise clients. You will bridge complex client business requirements with BT’s industry\-leading Managed Network Services, Global Fabric, and Multi\-Cloud connectivity portfolio.
  
In this role, you will lead the technical strategy and end\-to\-end architecture design for transformative deals—specifically integrating SD\-WAN, Enterprise Ethernet / Connectivity. You will work closely with BT Sales, Product Management, Commercial, and Delivery teams to create secure, resilient, and cost\-effective digital infrastructure solutions.
  
  

2\. Key Responsibilities
  
**Technical Leadership \& Discovery:** Lead pre\-sales discovery workshops with senior enterprise stakeholders (CTO, Head of Network, Lead Architects) to capture business objectives, technical constraints, and operational requirements.
  
**Solution Architecture \& Design:** Author comprehensive High\-Level Designs (HLD), Bill of Materials (BOM), and Statements of Work (SOW) spanning core networking, cloud connectivity, and managed services.
  
**Portfolio Integration:** Architect integrated solutions combining:
  
**SD\-WAN \& SASE:** Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela), Fortinet, Versa, or VMware SD\-WAN (Velocloud) overlay architectures with integrated security features.
  
**Ethernet \& Transport:** BT Wholesale/Openreach Ethernet services, E\-Line/E\-LAN, Direct Internet Access (DIA), Wavelengths, and MEF\-compliant carrier connectivity.
  
**Commercial \& Bid Support:** Collaborate with BT Bid Management and Commercial Pricing teams to ensure solution feasibility, SLA compliance, margin optimization, and competitive positioning against major MSPs/telecoms.
  
**Proof of Concept (PoC):** Define PoC success criteria, lead technical demonstrations, and validate complex WAN\-to\-cloud failover and performance scenarios for prospective clients.
  
**Governance \& Handover:** Ensure all designs pass internal BT technical governance reviews and lead seamless transition handovers from Pre\-Sales to Engineering and Delivery teams.
  
  

3\. Candidate Experience \& Skills
  
  

Required Technical Expertise
  
**SD\-WAN \& SASE:** Deep expertise in design, migration, and optimization using leading vendor platforms (Cisco SD\-WAN/Viptela, Fortinet NSE, Versa, or Velocloud). Understanding of application\-aware routing, dynamic path selection, and cloud\-delivered security.
  
**Ethernet \& WAN Technologies:** Expert knowledge of Layer 2 / Layer 3 VPNs, MPLS, Carrier Ethernet standards (MEF), BGP, OSPF, enterprise routing/switching, and local access tail circuit architecture.
  
Professional Experience \& Soft Skills
  
5\+ years in a Solution Architect, Pre\-Sales Engineer, or Principal Technical Consultant role within a Telecom Operator, Managed Service Provider (MSP), or Systems Integrator and overall 15\+ years of experience.
  
Excellent client\-facing presentation and communication skills, with a track record of translating complex technical concepts to non\-technical business leaders.
  
Strong commercial acumen and experience responding to enterprise RFPs, RFIs, and complex tenders.
  
  

4\. Desirable Certifications
  
**Networking \& SD\-WAN:** CCNP / CCIE (Enterprise / Service Provider), Fortinet NSE 4/7, MEF\-CECP.

6e61c9f6.title: Lead Solution Architect
6e61c9f6.description:
**Who We Are**
 WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
   

  

 The opportunity
   

  

 We are seeking a highly seasoned and visionary Lead Solution Architect to drive the digital transformation of our enterprise technology landscape. In this role, you will be the definitive technical authority responsible for designing, integrating, and scaling complex ecosystems that span E\-commerce platforms, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, and Content Management Systems (CMS).
   

  

 You will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution, designing modern, cloud\-native, and headless/composable solutions. The ideal candidate brings a wealth of experience in enterprise architecture and a proven portfolio of successfully leading multi\-million\-dollar digital commerce transformations.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

* Enterprise Architecture \& Solution Design
* Define and own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for digital platforms, seamlessly integrating E\-commerce engines, CMS (Digital Experience Platforms), and CRM systems.
* Champion modern architectural paradigms, specifically MACH (Microservices, API\-first, Cloud\-native, and Headless) and composable commerce strategies.
* Design robust data flows and integrations between digital storefronts, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), OMS (Order Management), PIM, and ERPs.
* Project Delivery \& Technical Leadership
* Serve as the primary architectural leader on large\-scale enterprise e\-commerce implementations, guiding technical teams from discovery and blueprinting through deployment and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Oversee the technical delivery of multi\-disciplinary squads (onshore and offshore), ensuring adherence to coding standards, security protocols, and CI/CD best practices.
* Mitigate technical risks and resolve complex integration or performance bottlenecks during peak traffic events.
* Stakeholder Management \& Pre\-Sales Support
* Act as a strategic advisor to C\-level executives, business stakeholders, and product owners, translating complex technical architectures into measurable business value.
* Lead architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and vendor evaluations (RFP/RFI processes).
* Estimate technical scope, resource requirements, and timelines for complex cross\-platform initiatives.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Overall Experience: Minimum of 13 to 15 years of progressive IT experience in software engineering, technical consulting, and enterprise system architecture.
* E\-Commerce Portfolio (Mandatory): Must have hands\-on architectural experience delivering at least 3 to 4 large\-scale, enterprise\-level E\-commerce projects (e.g., multi\-country rollouts, high\-volume transactional sites, complex B2B/B2C marketplace implementations).
* Multi\-Platform Expertise: Deep architectural knowledge in at least two of the following pillars, with working knowledge of the third:
* E\-commerce: SAP Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), or Composable platforms (commercetools, Spryker).
* CRM: Salesforce (Sales/Service Cloud), Microsoft Dynamics 365, or SAP CX.
* CMS/DXP: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore, Contentful, or Contentstack.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Integration Patterns: Extensive experience designing event\-driven architectures and API gateways using middleware/iPaaS tools (MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Kafka, or cloud\-native Pub/Sub).
* Cloud Platforms: Strong proficiency in architecting scalable infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Microservices \& Web Tech: Familiarity with modern front\-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue) used in headless setups, alongside backend microservices (Java, Node.js, or .NET).
* Data \& Security: Proven capability in designing secure systems compliant with GDPR/CCPA, integrating single sign\-on (SSO/IAM), and managing distributed data architectures.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Exceptional consultative skills with a track record of managing client expectations and steering digital strategy.
* High emotional intelligence and the ability to mentor Technical Leads and Senior Developers.
* Excellent presentation and white\-boarding skills.


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
   

  

 If you know some of this even better
   

  

 TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, or platform\-specific architect certifications (e.g., Salesforce B2C Commerce Architect, Sitecore Certified, etc.).
   

  

 What we can offer you
   

  

 Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
   

  

 Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
   

  

 We lead with
 **Heart** 
 , fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.
   

  

 We empower your
 **Brains** 
 for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
   

  

 And we champion
 **Courage** 
 , inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
   

  

 AT VML Enterprise Solutions
   

  

 Our Enterprise Solutions division houses strategic consultants, creative and technical architects and skilled developers and operators that together help some of the world’s leading organisations to deliver outstanding digital experiences across all major routes to market worldwide: marketplaces, online retailers, D2C, B2B and social platforms. With over 4,200 experts in 55 operational centres across 34 countries, our capabilities span the entire buying journey from customer acquisition, through engagement, to conversion and loyalty, driving multi\-channel growth for world\-leading brands.
   

  

 We work with some of the most exciting brands such as The Coca\-Cola Company, EY, Bosch, Unilever, Ford, DFS, Mercedes\-Benz, Johnson \& Johnson, Nestlé, Sainsbury’s, Selfridges, Shell and Tiffany \& Co. We’ve built over 500 platforms for brands and retailers and generate in excess of $29bn annually for our clients and work with over 50 strategic partners including Adobe, SAP, Salesforce, HCL, Shopify, Sitecore, BigCommerce, commerce tools and Acquia. Our reputation is based on our people, and we believe we have some of the best in the business.
   

  

 As our business grows internationally, we’re looking for new people to join us on our journey to inspire and take a key role in shaping some of the best commerce solutions, services, and websites in the world. Working as a team, no problem is insurmountable; we share in our client’s successes and believe that anyone can show creative bravery no matter what their role is in the team.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

 WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

d3340dc9.title: ServiceNow Solutions Manager (Pre-Sales)
d3340dc9.description:
Overview:

Prodapt is seeking a ServiceNow Solutions Manager to be based in one of our India offices. You'll shape ServiceNow\-based, AI\-led solutions spanning our workflows \- combining deep telecom\-native (TMT) expertise with our agentic AI capabilities, and extending this solutioning approach to adjacent, non\-telco industries as Prodapt's portfolio grows \- that power our sales, alliances, and product development initiatives. The role is focused on architecting proposals, and providing technical solutioning during the sales cycle, with a strong emphasis on applying AI and agentic AI methodologies to ServiceNow solution design. This role requires 8\-10 years of relevant ServiceNow experience, hands\-on exposure to AI\-led solution design, and strong pre\-sales solutioning skills
Responsibilities:
* Partner with sales and alliances teams to architect ServiceNow\-based, AI\-led solutions across the entire TMT stack and adjacent non\-telco industries for prospective deals, RFPs, and RFIs
* Provide pre\-sales technical guidance across the Now Platform, including designing AI and agentic AI\-based methodologies to support deal qualification and positioning
* Deliver solution proposals, demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and technical presentations spotlighting Prodapt's agentic AI stack to prospects, partners, and internal stakeholders across telecom and other industry verticals
* Partner with the CTO Office to stay current on the ServiceNow platform roadmap, translating new capabilities into sales\-ready solution narratives for TMT and non\-telco engagements alike
* Support competitive positioning, scoping, and pricing inputs during the sales cycle
* Act as the technical point of contact between sales, alliances, and product teams during the pre\-sales phase, handing off solution designs\- to delivery teams, post\-sale
* Contribute to building reusable ServiceNow solution accelerators, reference architectures, and best practices that can be applied across TMT and non\-telco industry verticals


Requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or engineering
* 8\-10\+ years of ServiceNow experience, with a solid pre\-sales /solutioning background
* Familiarity with telecom\-specific ServiceNow modules (TMT) and TM Forum/MEF\-aligned solutions, along with the versatility to extend ServiceNow AI\-led solutioning approaches to non\-telco industries (media, technology, and other enterprise verticals)
* Hands\-on experience applying AI/GenAI solution design methodologies \- agentic workflow design, prompt engineering, and use\-case discovery \- to ServiceNow solutioning, along with a working understanding of how AI responses are grounded in enterprise data
* Hands\-on working knowledge of ServiceNow's agentic AI stack \- Now Assist, AI Agent Studio, Context Engine, AI Control Tower, RaptorDB Pro, and Now Platform SDK/Build Agent \- with the ability to design, configure, and demo solutions built on these capabilities
* ServiceNow certifications – CSA, CIS and/or CTA are preferred
* Strong presentation and demo skills; ability to translate technical capabilities into business value for prospects and stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work directly with CTO Office, sales, product and alliances leadership
* Telecom/communications industry domain experience is a must, with the ability to design and position ServiceNow AI\-led solutions for non\-telco industries as well
* Based in one of Prodapt's India offices

e1fd39bf.title: Delivery Manager / Consultant Specialist
e1fd39bf.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop and manage project strategies, securing stakeholder engagement for project plans, commitments, and modifications.
* Assist technology teams in managing delivery by balancing scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, communication, and budget.
* Collaborate with the technology team and Product Owner to enhance productivity through effective backlog management and Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and Lean.
* Oversee and report on progress, issues, dependencies, and risks to programme management and stakeholders, providing recommendations to sustain delivery momentum and benefit realisation.
* Ensure adherence to standard controls, driving teams towards compliance with frameworks, capability management, security controls, and technology architecture designs.
* Support the prioritisation of capabilities within the Value Stream, including the creation of Capability Investment Cases and Capability Hypothesis Statements.
* Identify and resolve delivery impediments, escalate issues to Portfolio/CIOs, and track key delivery risks and dependencies.
* Manage governance forums such as VS Reviews, Portfolio Syncs, Scrum of Scrums, PI Planning, and QBR.
* Maintain a comprehensive view of resource demand across the Value Stream (geography, skillset, grade), establish long\-term capacity plans with stakeholders, and manage Value Stream\-level delivery reporting (self\-service and exception reporting for senior stakeholders).


 To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:
   

  

* 10 years of IT experience with 5\+ years in Business \& Project Management, including project management in the banking domain.
* Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile (Scrum/Kanban), and hybrid delivery models.
* Knowledge of Avaloq technology (added advantage).
* Ability to manage distributed teams and lead multiple teams through subordinate managers, with accountability for independent budgets.
* Broad understanding of concepts and principles across multiple or rapidly evolving disciplines.

954343e3.description:
Responsible for leading the development of comprehensive solution architecture strategies, ensuring seamless integration of application solutions across teams and domains while maintaining robust technical foundations. The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.
   

  

* Lead and define solution architecture strategies, encompassing technology and architecture for seamless integration of application solutions across various teams and domains.
* Establish and maintain the architectural runway at a solution level, ensuring a robust technical foundation for the rapid and reliable creation of new functionalities and features across teams and ARTs.
* Collaborate with other architects to validate the feasibility and sustainability of solution architectures and application portfolio lifecycle planning, ensuring alignment with FedEx best practices and design standards.
* Oversee the management of non\-functional requirements and compliance to ensure that solution architectures meet essential quality attributes such as performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, meeting stakeholder acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with other architects to define the appropriate delivery approach for solution services, encompassing processes, methodologies, tooling, and partnerships for agreement on service design and delivery.
* Identify and manage technical risks and continuous improvement opportunities for solution architectures, leveraging expert business knowledge to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate new or emerging technologies utilized by internal teams, ensuring alignment with FedEx technological standards and potential integration into solution architectures.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to other IT architects to develop their skills and expertise in solution architecture leadership and execution.


 Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems and/or equivalent formal training or work experience. Relevant Master’s degree, TOGAF certification and SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred.
   

  

 Experience: Eight (8\) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment with a direct responsibility for strategy formulation and solution/technical architecture, as well as designing, architecting, developing, implementing and monitoring efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex business problems.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Fluency in English
* Accuracy \& Attention to Detail
* Influencing \& Persuasion
* Planning \& Organizing
* Problem Solving
* Project Management

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

****Job Summary****
 Synechron is seeking a
 **Murex Solution Architect** 
 with
 **10\+ years of experience** 
 to provide technology leadership, solution architecture guidance, and strategic direction for Murex\-related technology initiatives. The role is responsible for translating business requirements into technology solutions, guiding cross\-functional teams, supporting successful project delivery, and ensuring that technology roadmaps align with overall business strategy. The position contributes to business objectives by improving technology efficiency, supporting informed technology adoption, and delivering scalable, maintainable, and effective solutions.
   

  

****Required****
**Software Requirements (Required and Preferred)**
* In\-depth understanding of various technologies and software systems relevant to solution architecture and technology delivery.
* Understanding of software architecture and design patterns.
* Knowledge of cloud computing platforms and infrastructure.
* Knowledge of database management systems and data structures.
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
* Familiarity with project management tools and methodologies.
* Strong technical expertise across multiple areas of software development and technology.
* Experience using software delivery, documentation, collaboration, and project tracking tools.

* Murex solution architecture experience aligned with the 10\+ years of overall experience requirement.

****Preferred****
* Experience with current and supported versions of Murex and related technology components.
* Experience with cloud\-based architecture, infrastructure, and solution delivery.
* Experience using tools for source control, continuous integration, deployment, testing, monitoring, documentation, and project management.
* Experience developing technology roadmaps and supporting architecture governance.
* Experience evaluating new technologies and making recommendations for adoption.
* Experience managing vendor relationships and negotiating contracts.
* Experience implementing process changes that increase technology delivery efficiency.


****Overall Responsibilities****
* Lead and manage cross\-functional technology teams supporting Murex solution architecture and technology initiatives.

* Drive technology initiatives and ensure successful delivery of projects within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business objectives.
* Identify areas for improvement and implement process changes to increase efficiency.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technology solutions.
* Define and communicate solution architecture decisions, technical approaches, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Evaluate new technologies and make recommendations for adoption based on business value, technical suitability, maintainability, and delivery impact.
* Develop and maintain technology roadmaps and ensure alignment with overall business strategy.
* Apply software architecture principles and design patterns to support scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts where required.
* Promote efficient technology usage, maintainable designs, and responsible use of infrastructure to support sustainability objectives.
* Monitor delivery outcomes, address risks and issues, and support continuous improvement across technology initiatives.


****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****
* Strong technical expertise in multiple areas of software development and technology.
* Ability to understand and assess programming, scripting, configuration, and integration requirements relevant to Murex solution architecture.
* Ability to review technical implementations and guide development teams toward appropriate architectural solutions.


****Preferred****
* Experience with programming or scripting languages used within the assigned Murex and technology environment.
* Experience defining reusable components, automation approaches, or development standards.


**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****
* Knowledge of database management systems and data structures.
* Understanding of data modeling, data integrity, data access, data quality, and data lifecycle considerations.
* Ability to assess database\-related dependencies and their impact on solution architecture.
* Ability to guide teams in addressing data\-related risks and technical issues.


****Preferred****
* Experience with relational, distributed, or cloud\-based database technologies.
* Experience with data integration, migration, reconciliation, reporting, or data quality initiatives.
* Experience assessing database performance, scalability, and maintainability.


**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****
* Knowledge of cloud computing platforms and infrastructure.
* Understanding of cloud architecture, infrastructure components, deployment models, scalability, availability, monitoring, and service dependencies.
* Ability to evaluate the suitability of cloud\-based approaches for technology solutions.


****Preferred****
* Experience designing, deploying, or supporting cloud\-based technology solutions.
* Experience with infrastructure automation, containerization, cloud monitoring, and deployment practices.
* Experience promoting efficient infrastructure use and reducing unnecessary processing or resource consumption.


**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****
* Understanding of software architecture and design patterns.
* Ability to assess frameworks, libraries, reusable components, and technical dependencies relevant to Murex solutions.
* Ability to guide teams in selecting maintainable and scalable implementation approaches.


****Preferred****
* Experience with enterprise integration frameworks and reusable technology libraries.
* Experience defining modular solution designs and technical standards.
* Experience assessing framework suitability, lifecycle support, maintainability, and integration impact.


**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
* Familiarity with project management tools and methodologies.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle activities, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, release, and support.
* Experience leading technology projects and coordinating work across cross\-functional teams.
* Experience using tools for project tracking, documentation, issue management, collaboration, and delivery reporting.


****Preferred****
* Experience with continuous integration, continuous delivery, automated testing, release management, and deployment practices.
* Experience with architecture governance, technical roadmaps, delivery metrics, and process improvement.
* Experience managing project risks, dependencies, issues, and delivery priorities.


**Security Protocols**
****Essential****
* Understanding of secure software architecture and technology governance requirements.
* Awareness of authentication, authorization, access control, data protection, and secure handling of technical information.
* Ability to identify, assess, document, and escalate security and operational risks.


****Preferred****
* Experience incorporating security controls into Murex and related technology solutions.
* Experience supporting security reviews, risk assessments, audit activities, and remediation planning.


****Experience Requirements****
* Minimum overall experience required: 10\+ years.
* Experience in technology leadership, software development, solution architecture, and technology delivery.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and managing technology projects.
* Experience translating business requirements into technology solutions.
* Experience with cloud computing platforms and infrastructure.
* Experience applying Agile development methodologies and project management tools.
* Experience with software architecture, design patterns, database management systems, and data structures.
* Experience relevant to Murex solution architecture is required for the position.
* Experience in financial services or another regulated technology environment is preferred where relevant to the assignment.
* Candidates may qualify through an equivalent combination of Murex solution architecture, software development, technology leadership, project delivery, and demonstrated technical outcomes.
* The experience requirement should be assessed based on the scope of responsibilities, technical contribution, leadership involvement, and complexity of delivered solutions.


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements, clarify priorities, and define Murex and related technology solutions.
* Lead cross\-functional technology teams, participate in regular delivery and architecture meetings, and provide technical guidance and mentorship.
* Evaluate new technologies, develop and maintain technology roadmaps, and recommend solutions that support business strategy and delivery objectives.
* Manage project decisions, vendor relationships, technical dependencies, risks, and deliverables while ensuring successful project delivery.

* Maintain continuous professional development through relevant training, technical learning, knowledge sharing, and awareness of evolving technology practices.

* Ability to think strategically and translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Strong leadership skills and experience leading cross\-functional teams
* Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work well in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Mentorship and ability to provide technical guidance to team members


**Professional Competencies**

* Lead and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional technology teams while providing technical guidance, mentorship, and knowledge sharing.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, manage expectations, negotiate effectively, and support informed decisions.
* Adapt to changing business requirements, technologies, priorities, and delivery conditions while maintaining focus on quality and outcomes.
* Evaluate new technologies and identify opportunities for innovation, automation, process improvement, maintainability, and sustainable technology use.
* Manage time, priorities, dependencies, and competing deliverables effectively in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

* Support contract reviews, change management, risk registers, risk\-mitigation plans, and escalation of commercial, technical, or execution risks.
* Support strategic customer engagements, project escalations, and site\-level issue resolution when local capability or remote support is insufficient.
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources and subject\-matter experts to resolve complex project challenges.
* Coach and train project managers on contractual conditions, technical specifications, risk management, lessons learned, closeout practices, and standardized execution processes.
* Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, standardized processes, lean and flow practices, and scalable solutions across multiple manufacturing locations.
* Present portfolio performance, project progress, risks, and recommended actions to senior and executive management.
* Travel to manufacturing sites and customer locations as needed for reviews, training, cross\-functional issue resolution, and customer support .


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in valves, actuators, related industrial equipment, manufacturing, EPC, project management, or department\-management roles.
* At least 5 years of progressive experience leading international capital\-equipment procurement projects involving engineered\-to\-order equipment.
* Knowledge of capital\-project execution, EPC projects, or engineered\-to\-order manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading through influence in a matrix organization and working effectively with stakeholders outside direct reporting relationships.
* Familiarity with industrial standards including API, ISO, MSS, ASTM, and DIN.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Microsoft Project and PowerPoint, along with document\-control and risk\-management practices or tools.
* Strong analytical, commercial, organizational, communication, presentation, prioritization, and cross\-cultural collaboration skills.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
* Ability to travel up to 30%, including occasional short\-term international travel.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP, IAPM, or another recognized project\-management certification.

* Additional language capability and experience working across multiple cultures and manufacturing locations.

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, the ability to establish credibility and influence stakeholders, sound business judgment, effective prioritization, and a results\-driven mindset focused on safe execution, customer outcomes, financial performance, standardized processes, and continuous improvement

**Job Title:** 
**Senior Cloud Solution Architect**
**Location: Bangalore**
**About Unilever**
 With 3\.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.
   

  

 At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.
   

  

**About Gdt**
 GDT is the global digital and technology engine of Unilever offering business services, technology, and enterprise solutions. GDT serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end\-to\-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit.
   

  

**Business Context and Main Purpose of the Role**
 Unilever’s modern technology strategy focuses on accelerated digital transformation, AI\-driven value creation, sustainability, and a Product\-Centric operating model. The Cloud Platform Services (CPS) organisation plays a key role in enabling this strategy by delivering secure, scalable, automated, and cost‑efficient cloud platforms across our major Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) platforms. The Senior Cloud Solution Architect guides platform modernisation, AI‑ready architectures, FinOps maturity, automation expansion, and adoption of Unilever’s new operating framework built around product lines and value streams.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally with Global Digital Technology and partners to guide our customers on their cloud journey, listening and understanding their business requirement and helping design or advise them on the most appropriate cloud architecture for them. You will work closely work with our delivery partners and leading technology partners to ensure that systems are built to Unilevers exacting standards for security and availability ensuring that the Solution Architectures created satisfy customer’s requirements.
   

  

**Main Accountabilities**
* Partner with Cloud Services Engagement (CSE) teams and Product Line Owners to design cloud‑native, AI‑enabled architectures aligned to Unilever’s technology strategy and modern operating framework.
* Drive adoption of reusable cloud patterns, platform accelerators, automation frameworks, and best‑practice landing zones supporting Unilever’s product‑based delivery model.
* Lead technical discovery and value‑identification workshops with senior stakeholders across UniOps, Markets, and Platform teams to shape modernisation roadmaps.
* Ensure architectures align to security‑by‑design, FinOps, automation principles, resilience engineering, and responsible AI practices.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Teams, and Enterprise Architecture to translate business outcomes into cloud service capabilities and multi‑year roadmaps.
* Coach teams on cloud adoption, AI enablement, and modern engineering standards; contribute to capability building across CPS and wider UniOps.


**Key Skills And Relevant Experience**
**Skills \& Experience:**
* Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex technical concepts to senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Deep understanding of cloud‑native architecture, AI Hosting considerations, automation, security, and FinOps operating principles.
* Demonstrated experience influencing technology strategy across technology teams, geographies, and cross‑functional groups.
* Strong customer‑centric mindset and ability to identify business value through cloud solutions.
* Proven ability to lead cross‑functional engagements and align technical outcomes to enterprise‑level frameworks and strategies.
* 5\+ years as a Cloud Advisor or Senior Architect working with major CSPs (GCP, Azure).


**Minimum Qualifications**
* GCP Professional Cloud Architect
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ‑305\)
* Architecture and Governance certifications (ITIL, CISSP, TOGAF beneficial)
* Experience with Agile, DevOps, modern engineering tooling (GitHub, CI/CD, IaC, JIRA)


**Desirable Qualifications**
* Experience of using JIRA and other agile design toolsets, including any appropriate Agile methodology certifications (e.g. Scrum)


**BEHAVIOURS**
 Candidates would be required to show demonstration of the following behaviours:
   

  

* Accountability and Ownership \- Strive for high quality and success, empower yourself and others to make decisions.
* Be bold \- Challenge the status quo, be bold \& passionate about technology, think outside of the box and be willing to improve.
* Customer First \- Thinking about our customers constantly by providing them with the best tools, services and end user experiences.
* Collaboration \- Working in an openly creative culture, where all ideas are acknowledged encouraging innovation and transparency.
* Empowered \- Always be one step ahead, embrace change and challenges, initiate solutions and make decisions in good faith.


**Leadership Skills**
* CARE DEEPLY: We care about how consumers experience our brands, the growth and development of our people, and their impact on the planet. We emphasize the importance of performance and care, moving from ambiguity about success to fairness and transparency.
* FOCUS ON WHAT COUNTS: We prioritize what truly matters, setting clear and stretching goals. We aim to shift from having everything as a priority to focusing on fewer, bigger things that are delivered to conclusion and are being rewarded.
* STAY THREE STEPS AHEAD: We encourage bold and creative thinking to make breakthroughs in performance. We focus on anticipating and staying ahead of consumer needs and external trends, shifting from reacting to leading, shaping, and disrupting the market.
* DELIVER WITH EXCELLENCE: The emphasis is on delivering everything with excellence and pace, taking personal ownership, and holding each other accountable. We aim to shift from pride in thinking to pride in execution, developing breakthrough solutions and ensuring the best outcomes.


**Our commitment to Equality, Diversity \& Inclusion**
* Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

0074d35b.description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

**Job Description – Transformation Architect – AI / Automation (Senior Manager)**
**Function: Clients \& Industries, EY Global Delivery Services India LLP**

You will lead, program manage, architect, and deliver next generation solutions using modern AI (Gen AI, Agentic AI) , machine learning, deep learning, MLOps, automation, with cloud native engineering to transform managed service operations into scalable, cost effective, value driven, insight led, AI enabled service models. This role enables EY to accelerate value, enhance operational outcomes, and build the future ready Managed Services operations.

* Drive continuous improvement using AIOps, observability, predictive insights, and automation\-first processes.

**Technical Expertise Requirements**
**Use Cases \& Architecture (Must)**

* Hands\-on experience in architecting (technical \+ solution architecture) AI/ML\-driven transformation assets and platforms.

**Modern AI \& Agentic AI (Must)**
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs, GenAI, and Agentic AI systems deployed in production on cloud using cloud native capabilities.
* Expertise in multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-use agents, workflow agents, and enterprise\-safe agentic architectures.

**Machine Learning \& Deep Learning (Must)**

* Experience with CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, Transformers, and generative models.
* Proficiency in sklearn, MLlib, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent frameworks.

**MLOps \& AI Platform Engineering (Must)**

* Hands\-on experience with Azure ML, Databricks, AWS Sagemaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.


**Cloud\-Native AI Engineering (Must)**

* Data Engineering (Desirable)

* Experience with Databricks, Spark, and cloud\-native data engineering services.


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Ability to manage multiple Transformation programs simultaneously.
* 12–16 years of experience in AI\-driven technology delivery; 4–8\+ years in AI/ML leadership roles.
* Deep expertise in modern AI, ML/DL, MLOps, automation, and cloud\-native engineering.
* Strong Python development background.
* Experience building, deploying, and shipping large\-scale AI products in cloud\-native production environments.
* Experience identifying high\-value AI use cases through data\-driven value quantification.
* Proven track record delivering complex AI\-driven transformation programs.
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement abilities.
* Quality\-oriented and detail\-focused mindset.
* Ability to work independently and manage complex multi\-disciplinary programs.

**Core Capabilities**

* Effective communication and executive presence.

**Functional Capabilities**

* Strong team collaboration and ability to manage ambiguity.
* Highly motivated, proactive, and outcome\-oriented.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and multitasking abilities.


**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**
* Creative problem\-solving capability.
* Self\-driven attitude and strong ownership.
* Logical reasoning and high attention to detail.
* Ability to work across cultures and global teams.
* Strong networking and cross\-team collaboration.
* Ability to build trust, strengthen team cohesion, and celebrate success.


**What We Look For**
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Strong grounding in MLOps, AIOps, automation, and observability.

**What We Offer**

c69ec557.description:
**About Consent\-In by Leegality:**  

  



  

We Enable end\-to\-end DPDP and privacy compliance across customer and vendor journeys using one centralized platform.  

  



**Privacy Infrastructure:**  

  



* **Consentin:** An end\-to\-end DPDP and Privacy compliance platform for Indian businesses
* **Consentin Lens:** A data discovery platform for businesses to identify the personal data they collect and store.
  

### **Our Culture:**

At Leegality, trust, ownership, transparency, and having fun while doing meaningful work are core to how we operate — not just values on paper. Our team rated us an incredible 97 eNPS for FY 2023–24 — the highest among 175\+ startups surveyed.  

  



We focus deeply on helping our people grow and stay motivated. Some of the perks you’ll enjoy:  

  



* Bi\-annual performance appraisals
* A culture that rewards initiative, curiosity, and impact

  

If you're looking for a place where you can make a real difference while working with smart, driven, and genuinely nice people, welcome to Leegality.  

  



**Location: GGN/MUM/BGL (On\-Site)**  

  



**Role Overview:**
------------------

We are looking for a Privacy Solutions Consultant who can help large enterprises solve complex privacy and DPDP compliance challenges using technology.  

  



The ideal candidate has worked in a privacy consulting/advisory practice or enterprise privacy function and has hands\-on experience implementing privacy technology solutions.  

  



We are looking for someone who combines a strong understanding of privacy regulations with the ability to understand business processes and technology systems, identify privacy gaps, and translate privacy requirements into practical technology implementations.  

  



You will work closely with DPOs, CISOs, CXOs, Compliance teams, Digital Operations teams and technology stakeholders to understand their privacy programs, bring industry best practices to their privacy solutions and implement Consentin and allied solutions.  

  



**What You Will Do:**  

  



* Design practical implementation plans using Consentin and allied privacy solutions to address identified compliance gaps.
* Identify the right business processes, systems and data flows where solutions for Consent Management, Data Subject/Data Principal Rights, Third\-Party Management, Incident Management, Data Discovery and Privacy Risk Assessments should be implemented.
* Use Consentin to provide practical solutions to businesses’ compliance problems and bring industry best practices to their DPDP compliance programs
* Conduct requirement\-discovery discussions with DPOs, CISOs, CXOs, Compliance, Legal, Security, Digital Operations and Technology teams and translate privacy requirements into implementable solutions.
* Lead or support the implementation and configuration of privacy technology platforms, ensuring that the solution aligns with the client's regulatory, operational and technology requirements.
* Provide practical guidance to clients on compliance with DPDP, GDPR, CCPA and other relevant national and international privacy regulations.
* Apply relevant privacy, information security and governance frameworks such as ISO 27701, ISO 27001/2, ISO 27018, NIST and other applicable standards while designing solutions.
* Review and assess privacy controls to evaluate their effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Identify product improvements based on client implementations, privacy requirements and market needs, and work closely with Product and Engineering teams to translate these insights into product enhancements.
* Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and act as a trusted partner during privacy transformation and implementation programs.
* Work from client locations when required based on project needs.

**What We Are Looking For:**
----------------------------

* 2\-4 years of relevant experience in privacy consulting, privacy technology, privacy implementation, data protection or closely related roles.
* Experience working in a privacy consulting/advisory practice, privacy technology implementation team, or enterprise privacy function is strongly preferred.
* Hands\-on experience implementing privacy solutions such as OneTrust, BigID, Securiti, TrustArc or similar privacy technology platforms in large enterprises.
* Ability to understand a client's privacy program and translate regulatory requirements into business processes, system requirements and technology implementations.
* Strong working knowledge of privacy regulations such as India's DPDP Act, GDPR, CCPA or other data protection regimes.
* Experience interacting with senior stakeholders such as DPOs, CISOs, Compliance Heads, technology leaders and CXOs and the ability to independently conduct requirement and solution discussions.
* Understanding of privacy and information\-security frameworks such as ISO 27701, ISO 27001/2, ISO 27018 and NIST. Exposure to additional frameworks such as ISO 22301 or HITRUST is a plus.
* At least one recognised privacy certification such as CIPM, CIPT or CIPP/E, or willingness to obtain one before joining.
* Strong problem\-solving and consulting skills, with the ability to move from "What does the regulation require?" to "How should we practically implement this for the client?"
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Hindi or Marathi proficiency is an advantage.

------------------------

0cfc76cf.title: Senior Solution Architect
0cfc76cf.description:
**Role:** Senior Solution Architect
**Location:** India, Remote (India NCR preferred)
**Experience:** 10 Years  

  

Algoworks
www.algoworks.com  

  

**About the company**  

  

Algoworks is an award\-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and India. We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable results.  

  

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. Our work combines human\-centered design, engineering excellence and AI\-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem\-solving and continuous improvement.  

  

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.  

  

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.  

  

Follow the video below to know about us! Clipchamp  

  

**Role overview**  

  

Algoworks is seeking a world\-class, experienced and highly hands\-on Atlassian Solution Architect to lead the architecture, governance, optimization and evolution of our Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Jira Service Management, Tempo and related capabilities.  

  

This role is responsible for ensuring the Atlassian platform operates as a scalable enterprise system rather than a collection of individual projects, workflows and configurations. The architect will combine deep Atlassian expertise with strong systems thinking and business understanding to design simple, secure, maintainable solutions that improve delivery, governance, productivity and data quality.  

  

The successful candidate must be proactive and naturally curious about platform health. This person should continuously inspect the environment, identify control gaps, configuration sprawl, technical debt, security risks, inefficient workflows and data\-quality issues and independently drive scalable remediation rather than waiting for problems to be assigned.  

  

The architect will set the technical direction, platform standards and solution patterns within which administrators and business teams operate, while remaining hands\-on enough to prototype, troubleshoot and validate complex solutions personally.  

  

**Key responsibilities:**  

  

**1\.Atlassian architecture and strategy**
* Define and continuously evolve the enterprise architecture and roadmap for Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Tempo and related Atlassian capabilities.
* Design scalable standards for projects, workflows, issue types, schemes, fields, screens, permissions, roles, automation, applications and integrations.
* Establish reusable configuration patterns that reduce unnecessary customization, simplify administration and prevent technical debt.
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, scalability, security, maintainability and cost.

**2\.Platform governance, health and continuous optimization**
* Continuously assess the Atlassian environment for architectural weaknesses, configuration sprawl, redundant fields and workflows, excessive permissions, control gaps and performance risks.
* Identify root causes behind recurring platform issues and replace workarounds or manual fixes with sustainable system\-level solutions.
* Establish governance for access, configuration changes, applications, automation and platform standards, with appropriate testing, deployment and rollback controls.
* Maintain clear architecture documentation, configuration standards and technical decision records so the platform remains governable as the organization scales.

**3\.Business process and solution design**
* Partner with Delivery, PMO, Finance, HR, Sales, IT and leadership to understand business processes and translate them into effective Atlassian solutions.
* Analyze the underlying business problem before recommending configuration, automation, customization or integration and challenge approaches that create unnecessary complexity.
* Design solutions that balance user experience, governance, reporting, automation and long\-term maintainability.
* Measure the effectiveness of major platform changes through clear improvements in productivity, control, data quality, visibility or business outcomes.

**4\.Automation, AI and extensibility**
* Proactively identify repetitive, manual or error\-prone processes that can be automated within or around the Atlassian ecosystem.
* Design scalable Jira and Tempo automation with appropriate validation, exception handling, monitoring and awareness of platform limits.
* Use APIs, scripting, cloud services or custom extensions when native capabilities are insufficient, while avoiding unnecessary custom development.
* Evaluate and implement AI\-enabled capabilities that improve project management, reporting, support, knowledge management and administrative productivity.

**5\.Enterprise integration, data and reporting**
* Architect reliable integrations between Atlassian and enterprise platforms such as CRM, ERP, HCM, identity, Microsoft/Azure and business intelligence systems.
* Define system\-of\-record responsibilities, data models, mappings, APIs, authentication, synchronization rules, reconciliation and error\-handling controls.
* Ensure Jira and Tempo are structured to produce accurate, consistent and decision\-ready data without excessive manual transformation.
* Partner with analytics teams to enable automated operational and executive reporting and resolve data\-quality issues at their source.

**6\.Technical leadership and platform enablement**
* Provide architectural direction and technical guidance to Jira Administrators and other teams working within the Atlassian ecosystem.
* Review significant changes for architectural impact, scalability, security and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Lead solution design, technical assessments, proofs of concept and major platform enhancements from concept through implementation.
* Develop team capability so recurring administration can be executed independently within clear architectural and governance standards.
  

  

**Required skills and qualifications:**  

  

* 10\+ years of experience across Atlassian platforms, enterprise applications or solution architecture, with significant hands\-on Jira experience.
* Deep expertise in Jira Cloud, Jira Service Management, Confluence and the broader Atlassian ecosystem.
* Strong experience with Tempo and enterprise time, resource, capacity or delivery\-management use cases.
* Expert understanding of Jira workflows, schemes, issue types, custom fields, screens, roles, permissions, automation and application architecture.
* Proven experience designing and simplifying enterprise\-scale Atlassian environments.
* Strong experience with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, scripting and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Atlassian with CRM, ERP, HCM, identity, cloud and analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, access governance, SSO, user provisioning and auditability.
* Proven ability to proactively identify architectural weaknesses and independently design scalable remediation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across systems, data, integrations and business processes.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into simple, maintainable technical solutions and communicate clearly with engineers and senior business stakeholders.
  

  

**Must have skills:**  

  

* Jira Cloud, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Tempo – enterprise architecture and administration.
* Strong expertise in Jira workflows, schemes, permissions, custom fields, automation and governance.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, scripting and enterprise integrations.
* Strong Atlassian solution architecture, security, scalability and technical\-debt management experience.
  

  

**Good to have skills:**  

  

* Experience with Atlassian integrations with Azure, CRM, ERP, HCM and BI platforms.
* Knowledge of SSO, identity management, access governance and audit controls.
* Experience with AI\-enabled automation and Atlassian extensibility.
  

  

**Desired attributes:**  

  

* Deeply curious about how systems work, where they fail and how they can be improved.
* Proactively identifies problems instead of waiting for tickets, incidents or instructions.
* Thinks in enterprise architecture rather than isolated Jira configurations.
* Strong instinct for simplifying complexity and eliminating technical debt.
* Hands\-on enough to prototype, troubleshoot and validate solutions personally.
* Comfortable challenging existing approaches and proposing better alternatives.
* Makes decisions based on scalability, maintainability, security and measurable business value.
* Rigorous, analytical and detail\-oriented with strong follow\-through.
* AI\-savvy and continuously explores better ways to automate work.
* Strong communicator and collaborative partner across technical and business teams.
* Fun, engaging personality and a team player.
  

  

**Interview process**
2 rounds of discussion.

beb8e9bb.title: IT Architecture Expert
beb8e9bb.description:
The European Technology Chamber (EUTECH) is a registered NGO that enables European companies to use their technologies for the benefit of Europe and mankind—following our vision: “Technology obliges.”


As Europe’s leading tech network, we are continuously expanding our international team and are looking for an experienced:


**Senior IT Architecture Expert (m/f/d) – 100% Remote**
-------------------------------------------------------


### **Your Mission**


You define and govern the end\-to\-end IT architecture across our central datacenter in Germany, office locations, and hybrid cloud environment. You ensure that our infrastructure, network, security, Hyper\-V, server, and identity architectures are secure, scalable, resilient, and standardised.


This is an architecture and governance role: you define what must be built and why , while operational teams manage the day\-to\-day implementation and administration.

  

  

**Your Daily Tasks**
--------------------


* Define and maintain the target architecture for datacenter, network, security, servers, virtualisation, cloud, and identity.
* Design and govern secure connectivity between the central datacenter and office locations.
* Define standards for LAN, WAN, VPN, IP addressing, VLANs, network segmentation, redundancy, and failover.
* Act as the architecture authority for Sophos Firewall , firewall zones, VPN security, and inter\-site traffic flows.
* Define and govern Microsoft Hyper\-V architecture as the exclusive on\-premises virtualisation platform.
* Review and approve major infrastructure, network, office connectivity, firewall, and Hyper\-V designs.
* Develop hybrid architectures connecting on\-premises infrastructure with Microsoft Azure .
* Ensure that Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, network, and security architectures are aligned.
* Apply Zero Trust, least\-privilege, compliance, and business\-continuity principles to all architecture decisions.
* Create and maintain architecture standards, reference designs, topology diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Work closely with infrastructure, server, security, and project teams to prevent technical debt and design drift.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering , or a related field from a top\-tier university.
* At least 12 years of experience in enterprise IT environments.
* At least 5 years of experience in a senior infrastructure, solution, or IT architecture role.
* Proven experience designing enterprise datacenters and multi\-site network architectures.
* Expert\-level knowledge of Microsoft Hyper\-V , including host, cluster, high\-availability, and resiliency designs.
