3a1ea424.title: Distinguished Field Solutions Engineer (AVP)
3a1ea424.description:
Distinguished Field Solutions Engineer
   

  

 Leading at Cognizant
   

  

 This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Distinguished Field Solutions Engineer, you will make an impact by serving as the senior technical leader for Cognizant AI Platforms and driving technical wins across enterprise pursuits.
   

  

 The Distinguished Field Solutions Engineer (Distinguished FSE) is the senior technical anchor of an enterprise platform deal — an intensely client\-facing and market\-facing role at the front line of our go\-to\-market motion, engaging clients directly and championing our platforms in the market.
   

  

 The FSE sits alongside account and sales teams to translate a client's engineering, AI, cloud and operations challenges into a credible, demonstrable solution built on our platforms.
   

  

 The FSE owns the technical win: discovery, architecture fit, demos, proofs of concept, and the technical narrative that carries a deal from first conversation to signed commercial model.
   

  

 Sales and commercial outcomes follow as a by\-product of the mindshare and client confidence the FSE earns, rather than from direct selling.
   

  

 Beyond the core technical\-win role, the Distinguished FSE is also expected to:
   

  

 Shape the direction of our platforms, and provide direction and oversight to the Product Managers in Platform Engineering.
   

  

 Anticipate technology trends and client needs, keeping the portfolio ahead of the market.
   

  

 Lead and grow the India\-based PoC and Demo team.
   

  

 Set the global standard for demos and coach demo teams worldwide.
   

  

 Drive sales and adoption across our go\-to\-market teams.
   

  

 Publish communications and success stories that build market momentum.
   

  

 Provide mindshare across AI Platforms and to senior levels within the firm.
   

  

 In This Role, You Will
   

  

 Lead technical strategy, influence platform roadmap, build PoC and Demo teams, and represent Cognizant in client and industry engagements.
   

  

 Partners with sales, account and professional services teams as the technical lead on enterprise platform pursuits, owning the technical win from qualification to close.
   

  

 Runs technical discovery to understand a client's engineering, AI, cloud and operations landscape, and maps their outcomes to the right platform or combination of platforms.
   

  

 Designs and presents solution architectures that show how our platforms integrate with the client's existing tooling, hyperscaler footprint and ecosystem partners.
   

  

 Builds and delivers compelling, tailored demonstrations and drives proofs of concept and readiness assessments that de\-risk adoption and prove value.
   

  

 Articulates the commercial and delivery value of platforms — including chargeback, managed\-services and outcome\-based models — and helps quantify productivity, cost and time\-to\-market benefits.
   

  

 Responds to the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs and bid processes, and shapes proposals with credible, defensible solutioning.
   

  

 Represents the platforms at industry events and conferences (e.g. AWS re:Invent, Google Next, Microsoft Ignite) and in cloud\-marketplace and partner motions.
   

  

 Champions the platforms in the market — building client mindshare and establishing Cognizant as a leading software firm and our platforms as best\-in\-class software.
   

  

 Serves as the voice of the field into the platform roadmap — capturing recurring client requirements and field feedback, prioritizing them with our Platform Engineering teams, and shaping where the platforms go next; then takes new capabilities and releases back to clients and the field to drive adoption.
   

  

 Acts as a primary stakeholder to the Product Managers within Platform Engineering — providing direction and oversight on priorities, requirements and release decisions so the roadmap reflects field and client reality.
   

  

 Hands off to our implementation teams and Forward Deployed Engineers for delivery, protecting adoption and reducing churn once a platform is adopted.
   

  

 Identifies opportunities to leverage our Forward Deployed Engineers to drive platform adoption across the client's estate, driving outcomes and creating value for clients.
   

  

 Leads, grows and manages a team of PoC and Demo specialists in India — hiring, coaching, developing talent, managing performance and planning capacity across concurrent pursuits — and mentors FSEs to scale the technical go\-to\-market motion.
   

  

 Defines demo needs and tailors demonstrations for specific audiences — from hands\-on engineers to C\-suite buyers — so each story lands with the right depth and messaging.
   

  

 Trains and coaches our demo teams globally on how to deliver demonstrations and the messaging that goes with them, raising demo quality across the firm.
   

  

 Works continuously across our Commercial, Delivery, Marketing and Solution Architect teams to improve the sales velocity and adoption of the platforms.
   

  

 Publishes timely communications and success stories — client wins, case studies, new releases and platform achievements — to build mindshare internally and in the market.
   

  

 Observes technology trends and evolving client needs, and anticipates which trends our platforms should address proactively — keeping the portfolio ahead of the market.
   

  

 Provides mindshare across AI Platforms leadership — including regular, direct briefings to senior levels within the firm — on field insight, client needs and platform direction.
   

  

 What You Need to Have to Be Considered
   

  

 20\+ years of software, AI, cloud or engineering experience with strong client\-facing leadership and people management skills.
   

  

 A senior software or platform product engineer — for example an advisory/solutions engineer, developer advocate or solution architect for a software product, who has moved decisively into a client\-facing technical go\-to\-market leadership role; experience in software products is valued over IT\-services.
   

  

 On that foundation, 20\-25 years in software, AI, digital and cloud engineering — including 7\+ years in advisory\-led technical conversations on software products and platforms with senior client engineers and architects and C\-suite technology leaders (CTO, CDO, CIO, CAIO).
   

  

 Proven people\-leadership experience — building, managing and developing technical teams (ideally PoC, demo, presales or solutions\-engineering teams), with the maturity to lead a technical team in India across concurrent, high\-stakes pursuits.
   

  

 A product mindset — demonstrated ability to shape product roadmaps, prioritize competing requirements and translate field feedback into product direction, without needing a formal product\-management title.
   

  

 Minimum 2\+ years hands\-on across the AI\-infused Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) — modern engineering and DevSecOps, legacy and cloud modernization for AI readiness, AI assurance (quality testing and performance\-drift monitoring) and run operations (SRE / AIOps) — and the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC), building agentic and gen\-AI solutions with large language and performance\-optimized small language models.
   

  

 Working knowledge of our key partner ecosystems — hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft, Google) and AI\-native providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA) — and the surrounding AI/engineering tooling (LLM providers, orchestration frameworks, CI/CD and observability).
   

  

 Excellent communication and storytelling — able to build and deliver demos, and to write and publish crisp communications and success stories, that translate technical capability into clear business outcomes.
   

  

 Comfort operating in ambiguity, managing multiple pursuits, and collaborating across our Commercial, Delivery, Marketing and Communications, Platform Engineering, Demo and Workshops, Solution Architect and implementation/Forward Deployed Engineering teams.
   

  

 Willingness to travel to client sites, studios and industry events as required.
   

  

 These Will Help You Succeed
   

  

 Hyperscaler certifications, SaaS/PaaS platform experience, product strategy exposure, and marketplace/co\-sell experience.

c88169ba.title: Principal Solutions Consultant — Managed Services (APAC)
c88169ba.description:
**About The Company**
 Keka is a SaaS HRMS platform, helping companies manage the entire employee lifecycle efficiently– hiring, onboarding, time \& attendance, payroll, performance, and learning in one integrated system.
   

  

 We have been in the market for 10\+ years and currently serve around ten thousand clients in India, US and GCC.
   

  

**Context**
 Keka is standing up its Managed Services (MS) business. MS is not a BPO — it is Keka running the customer's payroll, statutory, and HR operations on the Keka HRMS platform they already have (or would move to). Same platform, same data, same employee experience, new operating model.
   

  

 This role covers the APAC region — primarily Philippines, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Indonesia. Where deals extend into Middle East or Europe, you carry the technical narrative there as well.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Solutioning is your primary responsibility.** 
 You are the APAC country expert who owns Payroll / Statutory / Time \& Attendance depth for the market. You sit in prospect calls, create need for MS, defend and shape scope, and push deals through to closure. You are not a passive expert — you carry the deal.
   

  

 Beyond Solutioning, you partner across three functions to make sure the motion holds together: GTM (support and enable Sales), Product (bridge to R\&D on functional gaps), and Delivery (track project health post\-signature). You do not execute delivery or own partnerships — those live elsewhere. Your job is to close deals and make sure closed deals stay healthy.
   

  

**Primary Responsibility \- Solutioning**
**Country Expertise**
* Statutory framework depth. Philippines (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag\-IBIG, BIR, 13th month, service incentive leave), Singapore (CPF, IRAS, SDL), Australia (ATO STP Phase 2, superannuation, PAYG), New Zealand (IRD, KiwiSaver), Malaysia (EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB), Hong Kong (MPF, IRD), Indonesia (BPJS, PPh 21\). Regional peculiarities: 13th\-month pay, gratuity variants, non\-resident tax withholding, cross\-border employment.
* Payroll components. Gross\-to\-net mechanics, salary structures, reimbursements, garnishments, F\&F settlements, prior\-vendor cleanup patterns.
* Time \& Attendance. Attendance\-to\-payroll pipelines, overtime rules, PTO / leave policy design, statutory paid leave.
* Compliance rhythm. Notice triage cadence, audit prep, peak\-load moments (year\-end, statutory season) that customers panic about.


**Sales\-Call presence**
* Create need. Walk a prospect through their own pain in ways they had not articulated. Turn "we already do payroll" into "we already lose Ops leaders to payroll."
* Defend and shape scope. Hold the SKU line where it matters; concede where it wins the deal. Know the difference cold.
* Carry the technical narrative from first\-call to signed MSA. RFP responses, security questionnaires, statutory Q\&A, delivery walk\-throughs.
* Competitive positioning. Displacement plays against Deel, Papaya Global, Remote, Multiplier, Rippling APAC, Neeyamo APAC, and regional incumbents (JustLogin in SGP, HR2Eazy in MY, Sprout in PH, ELMO / Employment Hero in AU) — know each competitor's weak spots cold.


**Secondary Responsibilities**
**GTM \- Support and enable**
* Enable Sales (Farming \+ Hunting) with talk tracks, objection handling, and country\-specific scope walkthroughs — delivered via the Enablement team.
* Contribute to MS content the Marketing team produces: pitch decks, scope\-by\-SKU 2\-pagers, displacement battlecards, case studies. Ensure the content is factually correct and prospect\-tested.
* Feed back what is landing and what is not from prospect calls, so content and positioning evolve on a fast cadence.


**Product \- bridge, not build**
* Translate recurring prospect and delivery pain into structured Product requirements (not anecdotes).
* Track those requirements through Product's roadmap. When a Product gap blocks an MS deal, pull it forward with a data\-backed case.
* When Product ships something useful, get it into pitch decks and battlecards within a week.


**Delivery \- track, not execute**
* Monitor delivery health on the accounts you closed — cycle accuracy, SLA adherence, escalations, renewal signals.
* Flag risks to Delivery leads early; hand off cleanly and stay available as escalation backup.
* Own the debrief when a deal closes — what did we sell, what does Delivery need to deliver, where are the known risks.


**What You Bring**
* Deep payroll expertise for APAC. You can walk any prospect through statutory framework, filing calendars, and edge cases without notes.
* 6\+ years in HR Tech, payroll, or global employer\-of\-record. Ideally split between hands\-on delivery and client\-facing / commercial roles. Companies like Deel, Papaya Global, Remote, Multiplier, Neeyamo, Employment Hero, JustLogin, Sprout Solutions, ADP APAC, TMF Group are the right shape of pedigree.
* Sales\-call fluency. You have sat in front of CHROs, CFOs, and Heads of People and closed. You know when to push and when to concede scope.
* Strong communication — written and verbal. Comfortable running executive\-level prospect calls.
* Numeracy and structured thinking. Comfortable with pricing math and SKU logic; can build your own analysis when the ask is ambiguous.


**Nice to have**
* Multi\-country payroll implementation exposure.
* Formal certifications — CPP / FPC (US), Certified Payroll Manager (India), or geo equivalents.
* Experience contributing to battlecards, competitive positioning, or sales playbooks.
* Bonus depth in Middle East payroll (UAE / KSA / BAH / QAT — SIF/WPS, GOSI, gratuity) or select European markets (UK PAYE, DE Lohnsteuer, FR URSSAF).

1d6be85c.title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
1d6be85c.description:
About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  

About the Role
  
  

As a member of Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy and manage infrastructure, application components and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable and sustainable. You will also work with Apps Integration and the DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall Support Process.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
  

* Automation for tasks like deployment of servers and application software across environment, alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work\-arounds and resolution of reported issues
* Quickly \& effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve troubleshooting process in the long run
* Ensure the stability and availability of Application operation components running on Public Clouds.
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotation to support production environments and shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right\-size servers and services
* Migrate on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related discipline
* At least 3 years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices. Hands on experience with DevOps Tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, TFS
* Experience with cloud platforms like AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, PowerShell
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
* Hands\-on experience in Linux/Windows server operating systems, and Web Server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere and Apache Web Server
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres or MySQL
* Proven ability to work in a team\-oriented environment, providing back\-up support to team members \& establishing/maintaining effective work relationships with co\-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.


Desired Qualifications
  
  

* 5\+ years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices
* Experience migrating on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation and shift work to support production environments
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need base


Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

a7b10e5c.description:
In this role, you will manage a team for one of Solution Areas and bring thought leadership in customer engagement. 5caa4563.title: Technical Program Manager - Core Network Delivery & MNO Onboarding
5caa4563.description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
 Skylo has pioneered a standards\-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
   

  

 Our direct\-to\-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier\-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards\-based, cloud\-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
   

  

 When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass\-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
   

  

**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. You will collaborate with a high\-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones.*
**How You Will Impact Skylo**
 You will own end\-to\-end program delivery across the three systems that determine whether an MNO partner can be onboarded, whether traffic flows correctly, and whether it settles correctly: the
 **packet core** 
 , the
 **signalling plane** 
 , and
 **billing \& settlement** 
 . You sit at the seam between Network Engineering, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance/Billing, and external partners (MNOs, IPX providers, clearing houses, roaming suppliers), and you are accountable for turning a growing partner pipeline into predictable, on\-time technical delivery.
   

  

 This is a builder's role. You will be defining the onboarding program, the release cadence, and the launch\-readiness bar — not inheriting a mature machine.v
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* wn the MNO technical onboarding program end\-to\-end from the core/signalling/billing lens — integration milestones, dependencies, Definitions of Done, and cutover plans across the partner lifecycle.
* Drive signalling delivery programs: Diameter interfaces (S6a, SGd), MAP\-over\-IPX via IWF, DRA configuration and routing policy, SMS\-over\-NAS enablement, and roaming signalling readiness per partner.
* Coordinate billing \& settlement programs: TAP3 / RAP / NRTRDE exchange, BCE readiness, mediation and rating, CDR integrity and reconciliation, and integration with settlement and finance systems.
* Program\-manage the multi\-supplier roaming stack — supplier onboarding, contractual/technical cutover, parallel\-run and rollback planning, and de\-risking the transition away from single\-supplier dependency.
* Run program governance: maintain roadmaps, RAID logs, release trains, and cross\-functional launch\-readiness reviews; make dependencies and risks visible before they become escalations.
* Own the metrics that matter: onboarding cycle time, signalling success/attach rates, routing correctness, CDR and settlement accuracy, and billing\-run reliability — and report them to engineering and commercial leadership.
* Be the translation layer between deep network engineering and commercial/partner stakeholders, so that partner commitments and network reality stay aligned.


**Sound like you? You bring:**
 You know how wholesale roaming works end to end, and you have the program management discipline to keep a complex multi\-partner portfolio running smoothly without losing track of the details.
   

  

* 8\+ years in mobile core / signalling engineering or technical program leadership, with deep, hands\-on time in the signalling plane
* Understanding of Signalling in 3GPP core, across EPC and 5GC:
+ NAS procedures (attach, TAU, service request) and the interfaces that carry them — S6a, S6c, S13, SGd, T6a — with fluency in Diameter base protocol, AVP design, realm/application routing, and error/overload handling.
+ DRA/DEA architecture: understanding of routing policy \& topology
+ A clear grasp of the SS7/MAP ↔ Diameter boundary and IWF interworking (e.g. legacy SMS via MAP over IPX vs. SGd Diameter).

* NB\-IoT / CIoT and NTN signalling specifics: control\-plane CIoT EPS optimisation, NIDD, and the way NTN propagation delay and timer handling (Rel\-17 NTN) change attach/retransmission behaviour.
* Hands\-on roaming operations: IREG/TADIG, IR.21/RAEX, IPX interconnect, and per\-partner signalling readiness.
* Working understanding of billing \& settlement as it depends on signalling and CDR generation: TAP3 (TD.57\), RAP (TD.32\), NRTRDE, and the CDR lifecycle from record generation to settlement.
* Demonstrated track record shipping cross\-functional network programs on time across engineering and external partners.
* Credible in a signalling design review and in a partner integration call alike — equally at home with core engineers and external carrier counterparts.Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of picking up new ones quickly.


**It Would Be Great If You Had Experience With**
* NTN, NB\-IoT, or cellular IoT connectivity experience.
* SMS\-over\-NAS delivery paths (SGd Diameter and MAP\-via\-IPX), and CIoT optimizations (NIDD, control\-plane CIoT).
* Experience with wholesale roaming, MVNO/MVNE, or roaming\-hub environments.
* Familiarity with BCE and next\-generation settlement, and with ERP/finance\-system integration for billing.
* Exposure to clearing\-house and IPX supplier commercial/technical management.


**What Success Looks Like (First 6\-12 Months)**
* A single, trusted onboarding program that partner\-facing and engineering teams both plan against — with cycle time trending down as volume grows.
* Signalling and billing readiness treated as a gated part of every partner launch, not a post\-launch surprise.
* The multi\-supplier roaming transition de\-risked with a clear cutover and rollback plan, and no single\-supplier lock\-in surprises.
* Program\-level visibility into signalling and settlement health that leadership actually uses to make calls.


**What We Offer**
 With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
   

  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plan
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct\-to\-device satellite network and service
* Access to world\-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics


**EEO Statement**
 Skylo is an equal\-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

a6849b33.title: Program Manager III, GCOI
a6849b33.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you excited about building and owning end\-to\-end catalog operations for one of Amazon's fastest\-growing grocery businesses? We are looking for a Sr. Program Manager to own Wholefoods' catalog operations and vendor migration support within the Grocery Catalog Operations \& Intel (GCOI) team.  

  

This role is the single\-threaded leader for catalog readiness across WFM's expansion into new marketplaces (UK, Canada) and Vendor Central migration (3,500 vendors). You will define program strategy, drive cross\-functional execution across 5\+ orgs (ASCS, GDO, GMT, Vendor Central, Amazon Retail), and own director\-level outcomes. You will build SOPs from scratch, set and enforce SLAs, publish readiness dashboards, and escalate before problems become launch blockers.  

  

If you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building structure where none exists, and want to own outcomes that directly enable cost savings and multi\-market grocery expansion \- this role is for you.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own end\-to\-end catalog readiness workback for new WFM marketplace launches (UK, Canada) — from intake through ASIN creation, EPI contribution, validation, and signoff
* Define and enforce catalog launch criteria; publish weekly readiness status to expansion PMs from T\-12 weeks


\- Maintain \- Own the catalog ops workback for each Vendor Central migration cohort (3,500 vendors) — track cross\-functional dependencies with defined SLAs, escalate silent blockers with data  

* Build and own the steady\-state vendor listing friction support workstream for WFM vendors on Vendor Central
* Drive cross\-organizational stakeholder engagement across WFM, ASCS, GDO, GMT, and Amazon Retail systems
* Own volume forecasting, HC planning against inflow, and intake channel design
* Define SOPs, escalation paths, and partner maps for international catalog maintenance and vendor listing workflows
* Communicate program status, risks, and go/no\-go recommendations to senior leadership

  

About the team  

GCOI (Grocery Catalog Operations \& Intel) owns catalog operations across Amazon's grocery ecosystem — Wholefoods, Grocery Partnerships, Amazon Fresh, and SSD\-G \& Quick Commerce. We support everything from ASIN/offer creation to attribute maintenance within ASCS. Our differentiator: deep domain knowledge of end\-to\-end catalog flows lets us design, build, and deploy automation without dedicated engineering headcount, collapsing the cycle from defect identification to automation within the same team.  

  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Knowledge of general AI tools

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

We work with the most exciting computing hardware and software, driving the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence. We need individuals who can enable customer productivity and develop lasting relationships with our technology partners, making NVIDIA an integral part of end\-user solutions. We are looking for someone always thinking about artificial intelligence, someone who can maintain constructive collaboration in a fast paced, rapidly evolving field, someone able to coordinate efforts between corporate marketing, industry business development and engineering. You will be working with the latest AI architecture coupled with the most advanced neural network models, changing the way people interact with technology.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Architect end\-to\-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs training , deployment and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language\-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI software.

* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.

0a536d51.title: Senior Solution Architect, Generative AI - CSP
0a536d51.description:
NVIDIA’s Solution Architect team is looking for a AI\-focused Solution Architect with expertise in Large Language Model, generative AI, agentic AI. We work with the most exciting computing hardware and software, driving the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence. We need individuals who can enable customer productivity and develop lasting relationships with our technology partners, making NVIDIA an integral part of end\-user solutions. We are looking for someone always thinking about artificial intelligence, someone who can maintain constructive collaboration in a fast paced, rapidly evolving field, someone able to coordinate efforts between corporate marketing, industry business development and engineering. You will be working with the latest AI architecture coupled with the most advanced neural network models, changing the way people interact with technology.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Architect end\-to\-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs training , deployment and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language\-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI software.
* Engage directly with customers/partners to understand their requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG\-based solutions.


**What We Need To See**
* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in a technical AI role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* Expertise in training and fine\-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as Megatron\-LM, Megatron\-Bridge, AutoModel and PyTorch.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on\-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

ac2ea0e3.description:
**Company Description** 
 Visteon is a global automotive technology company advancing mobility through software\-defined and electric vehicle solutions. The company develops next\-generation digital cockpit and electrification products to enable cleaner, safer, and more connected vehicle experiences. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries and generated approximately $3\.76 billion in annual sales, with $6 billion of new business booked in 2022\. Visteon India designs, engineers, and manufactures vehicle cockpit electronics for leading automakers, supported by technical centers in Chennai, Pune, Bangalore, and Goa. With a best\-in\-class manufacturing facility in Chennai, Visteon India focuses on delivering advanced global technology and innovative system solutions to its customers.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Project Delivery Manager role at Visteon India is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Chennai. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing project delivery activities for vehicle cockpit electronics programs, ensuring alignment with timelines, cost targets, and quality standards. The Project Delivery Manager oversees expediting of materials and components, manages logistics flows, and collaborates closely with engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and quality teams to resolve issues that may impact project milestones. Daily activities include monitoring project status, managing risks and dependencies, coordinating inspections and approvals, and preparing reports and updates for internal stakeholders and customers. The role also involves continuous improvement of delivery processes, supporting cross\-functional communication, and maintaining strong relationships with suppliers and partners to ensure reliable, on\-time delivery.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Project management skills, including Project Management, scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
* Expediting and Expeditor skills to track, prioritize, and accelerate delivery of critical materials and components.
* Inspection skills to coordinate and review product inspections, quality checks, and compliance with technical specifications.
* Logistics Management skills to oversee material flow, inventory coordination, and on\-time delivery to manufacturing and customer sites.
* Experience in automotive or electronics manufacturing environments, with familiarity in production processes and supply chain operations.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on meeting deadlines.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams and external partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field; advanced certifications in project management or logistics are an advantage.

We are looking for a Sr. Program Manager to own Wholefoods' catalog operations and vendor migration support within the Grocery Catalog Operations \& Intel (GCOI) team.
   

  

 This role is the single\-threaded leader for catalog readiness across WFM's expansion into new marketplaces (UK, Canada) and Vendor Central migration (3,500 vendors). You will define program strategy, drive cross\-functional execution across 5\+ orgs (ASCS, GDO, GMT, Vendor Central, Amazon Retail), and own director\-level outcomes. You will build SOPs from scratch, set and enforce SLAs, publish readiness dashboards, and escalate before problems become launch blockers.
   

  

 If you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building structure where none exists, and want to own outcomes that directly enable cost savings and multi\-market grocery expansion \- this role is for you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

- Own end\-to\-end catalog readiness workback for new WFM marketplace launches (UK, Canada) — from intake through ASIN creation, EPI contribution, validation, and signoff

- Define and enforce catalog launch criteria; publish weekly readiness status to expansion PMs from T\-12 weeks

 Maintain \<0\.5% ASIN gap rate on active international store catalogs with defined intake SLAs and 5\-business\-day turnaround for new items
 - Own the catalog ops workback for each Vendor Central migration cohort (3,500 vendors) — track cross\-functional dependencies with defined SLAs, escalate silent blockers with data

- Build and own the steady\-state vendor listing friction support workstream for WFM vendors on Vendor Central

- Drive cross\-organizational stakeholder engagement across WFM, ASCS, GDO, GMT, and Amazon Retail systems

- Own volume forecasting, HC planning against inflow, and intake channel design

- Define SOPs, escalation paths, and partner maps for international catalog maintenance and vendor listing workflows

- Communicate program status, risks, and go/no\-go recommendations to senior leadership

**About The Team**
 GCOI (Grocery Catalog Operations \& Intel) owns catalog operations across Amazon's grocery ecosystem — Wholefoods, Grocery Partnerships, Amazon Fresh, and SSD\-G \& Quick Commerce. We support everything from ASIN/offer creation to attribute maintenance within ASCS. Our differentiator: deep domain knowledge of end\-to\-end catalog flows lets us design, build, and deploy automation without dedicated engineering headcount, collapsing the cycle from defect identification to automation within the same team.

ac284f10.title: Architect - Identity & Access Management
ac284f10.description:
Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Senior IAM Analyst to lead and coordinate Identity and Access Management (IAM) initiatives across multiple business programs, applications, platforms, and transformation projects.


This role will serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, application teams, project managers, architects, cybersecurity teams, and IAM engineering teams to ensure successful delivery of IAM requirements throughout the project lifecycle.


The candidate will be responsible for understanding project scope, business requirements, timelines, dependencies, risks, and implementation plans while driving IAM workstreams to completion. The role requires strong stakeholder management, program coordination, requirement gathering, documentation, reporting, and IAM domain knowledge.


The ideal candidate combines project delivery discipline with practical IAM expertise across Identity Lifecycle Management, SSO, MFA, PAM, Directory Services, and Access Governance.


Responsibilities:  

IAM Program \& Project Management

* Manage and coordinate multiple IAM\-related initiatives simultaneously.
* Act as the primary point of contact between business/application teams and IAM teams.
* Understand project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, and dependencies.
* Ensure IAM requirements are identified early and incorporated into project plans.
* Track project deliverables, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Drive project execution and ensure timely closure of IAM action items.
* Facilitate governance meetings, project updates, and status reviews.
* Escalate critical risks and blockers appropriately.


Business Engagement \& Stakeholder Management

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional and security requirements.
* Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, cloud teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Act as a trusted advisor for IAM\-related requirements and best practices.
* Develop strong relationships with project sponsors and key stakeholders.
* Drive alignment across multiple cross\-functional teams.
* Manage stakeholder communications and expectations.


IAM Requirements \& Solution Coordination

* 9\+ yrs of experience in Gather, analyse, and document IAM requirements.
* Translate business requirements into IAM implementation requirements.
* Partner with IAM architects and engineering teams to define solutions.
* Validate proposed IAM designs align with business and security objectives.
* Coordinate implementation activities across teams.


Documentation \& Governance


Responsible for creation and maintenance of:

* Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), User Stories, Solution Design Documents, Process Flows, AM Architecture Inputs, Change Management Documentation, Operational Runbooks, Implementation Plans,Test Plans, Cutover Plans, Support Handover Documentation


Ensure all documentation is maintained according to enterprise standards.


Project Planning \& Execution

* Create and maintain project plans and implementation schedules.
* Support planning and dependency management.
* Coordinate project milestones and readiness activities.
* Ensure adherence to delivery timelines.
* Monitor progress and provide regular reporting to leadership.


Reporting \& Metrics

* Develop executive and operational status reports.
* Provide dashboards and reporting on:
* Present updates to leadership and governance forums.


Change Management \& Transition

* Facilitate transition from project teams to support teams.
* Ensure proper documentation and knowledge transfer.


Mergers, Acquisitions \& Divestitures (M\&A)

* Support IAM workstreams for M\&A initiatives.
* Participate in due diligence activities.
* Support Day\-1 readiness and transition activities.


Qualifications:  

Strong understanding and Hands\-on of IAM concepts including:


Identity Management

* Identity Lifecycle Management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver), User Provisioning and Deprovisioning, Role Management, Access Certification, Access Governance


Authentication \& Access

* Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Passwordless Authentication, Federation, Conditional Access, OAuth, OIDC, SAML


Privileged Access Management

* Privileged Account Governance, Secrets Management, Service Accounts, Privileged Session Management


Directory Services

* Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), LDAP, Identity Synchronization


Cloud \& SaaS

* AWS, Azure, GCP, Enterprise SaaS Applications


Documentation Skills

* BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Process Documentation, Runbooks, SOPs, Operational Documentation


Reporting

* Executive Reporting, Dashboard Creation, KPI Tracking, Metrics Analysis

5b815bb2.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Data Platform Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Data Platform Architect, a typical day involves designing and implementing the overall data platform architecture, ensuring that all components work seamlessly together. This role requires close collaboration with Integration Architects and Data Architects to align system integrations and data models effectively. The position demands a strategic approach to building a robust and scalable data platform blueprint that supports organizational needs and future growth. The architect continuously evaluates and refines the platform design to maintain cohesion and efficiency across various data systems and components.

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of data platform strategies to meet business objectives.
* Facilitate communication and coordination among cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment on data architecture goals.
* Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities.

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
* Experience with cloud\-based data solutions and distributed computing environments.
* Strong knowledge of data integration techniques and data modeling principles.
* Ability to design scalable and secure data architectures that support complex analytics workloads.
* Familiarity with data governance, data quality, and metadata management practices.

* The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
* This position is based at our Bhubaneswar office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

291533e2.description:
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
   

  

**Why we need this role**
 The Manager IT Infrastructure (M365, Azure, GCP, Windows \& VDI) is responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery, operation, and performance of critical enterprise platforms, including Microsoft 365, Azure, GCP, Windows Server, VDI, and Citrix services.
   

  

 The role leads a team of approximately 15 engineers, ensuring the secure, stable, and efficient operation of business\-critical services, while delivering roadmap initiatives, platform improvements, and automation outcomes aligned to architecture and strategy.
   

  

 Working closely with Architecture, Security, Development, and wider Operations teams, the role ensures solutions are delivered, integrated, and operated at scale, with strong focus on service reliability, security, cost efficiency, and user experience.
   

  

 The role embeds operational excellence, resilience, automation, and governance, driving standardisation and continuous improvement across cloud, workplace, and identity platforms. Through strong leadership and execution, it reduces risk, complexity, and operational overhead, while improving service performance, stability, and cost control.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Leads engineering and operational delivery across M365, Azure, GCP, Windows, and VDI platforms, ensuring services, tooling, and integrations are
 **secure** 
 ,
 **resilient** 
 ,
 **scalable** 
 , and
 **operationally effective** 
 .
   

  

* Microsoft 365 Platforms: Ownership of collaboration and productivity services (Teams, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune), including service performance, governance, security, lifecycle, and user experience.
* Azure \& GCP Cloud: Operational management of cloud platforms including landing zones, subscriptions/projects, connectivity, platform services, and governance controls.
* Windows \& End User Platforms: Management of Windows Server and end\-user compute platforms, including build, patching, configuration, and lifecycle.
* VDI \& Citrix: Delivery and operation of virtual desktop environments, ensuring performance, availability, and user experience.
* Identity \& Access: Operational ownership of Active Directory and Entra ID, including authentication, Conditional Access, privileged access, and directory services.
* Cloud Security \& Compliance: Enforcement of secure configurations, monitoring, logging, and policy controls across all platforms.
* Leads delivery of standardisation, automation, tooling, and operational consistency across cloud and workplace platforms


 Key Accountabilities
   

  

**Service Delivery, Engineering \& Operations**
* Lead the build, delivery, and operation of critical infrastructure services across M365, cloud, Windows, and VDI
* Ensure platforms meet availability, performance, and service level expectations
* Act as senior escalation point for major incidents and service issues


**Security, Resilience \& Service Stability**
* Ensure secure\-by\-design and operational security controls are implemented and maintained
* Own resilience, recoverability, monitoring, and service continuity across platforms


**Roadmap Delivery \& Continuous Improvement**
* Deliver platform roadmaps and improvement initiatives in line with architectural direction
* Drive continuous improvement in automation, efficiency, and service quality


**Team Leadership \& Capability Development**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing engineering team (FTE \& contingent)
* Build capability across cloud, workplace, and identity domains
* Ensure effective workload management, prioritisation, and delivery


**Cross\-Domain Collaboration \& Integration**
* Work with Architecture, Security, Development, and Operations teams to deliver integrated services
* Ensure solutions are fully transitioned, supported, and operationally sustainable


**Vendor \& Service Management**
* Ensure service performance, delivery quality, and issue resolution


**Operational Governance, Cost \& Optimisation**
* Ensure services are aligned to standards and governed through full lifecycle
* Manage operational cost, capacity, and efficiency
* Drive automation, standardisation, and reduction of technical debt and complexity


 Leadership \& Behavioural Expectations
   

  

 Operates as a senior leader with strong ownership, accountability, and delivery focus.
   

  

* Ownership \& Accountability: Owns service outcomes across availability, security, and cost
* Leadership \& Team Development: Builds, leads, and develops high\-performing teams
* Execution \& Delivery: Drives consistent, high\-quality service and platform delivery
* Collaboration \& Influence: Works effectively across domains and stakeholders
* Adaptability \& Improvement: Responds to operational challenges while driving automation and optimisation


**Essential**
**What we’re looking for**
* Extensive experience leading infrastructure engineering and operations teams in enterprise environments
* Strong expertise across Microsoft 365 and workplace services, Azure and GCP cloud operations, Windows Server, VDI/Citrix, and identity (Active Directory, Entra), with robust knowledge of security, resilience, operational controls, and automation tooling.
* Proven ability to manage business\-critical services at scale
* Strong stakeholder, vendor, and team leadership capability
* Excellent operational, analytical, and decision\-making skills


**Soft Skills \& Behavioural Competencies**
* Ownership \& Accountability: Takes responsibility for delivering outcomes and driving technical excellence.
* Leadership \& Influence: Ability to inspire, motivate, and guide team members toward achieving goals.
* Communication: Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical skills to troubleshoot complex issues and implement effective solutions.
* Collaboration: Skilled at building relationships and working effectively across teams and stakeholders.
* Adaptability: Comfortable managing priorities in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset: Proactive in identifying opportunities for process and technology enhancements.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, Citrix Certified Expert, VMware VCP, Google Cloud Professional Architect) preferred.


**What We Offer You**
**Looking to make a mark?**
 At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
   

  

 Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
   

  

 Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
   

  

 We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
   

  

**Diversity and inclusion**
* Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.


**Most Recently We Have**
* Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
* Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
* Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.


**Benefits**
 Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
   

  

* Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
* Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
* Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
* Global Family Leave Policy.
* Employee Assistance Program.
* Internal inclusion \& diversity employee networks.


**A global network**
* When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

174410c9.title: Technology Consultant - Cloud Infrastructure Architect
174410c9.description:
**Req ID:** 385811
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Technology Consultant \- Cloud Infrastructure Architect to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

**Job Title:** Technology Consultant – Cloud Infrastructure Architect
  
  

**Role Summary:**  

We are seeking an experienced Technology Consultant – Cloud Infrastructure Architect to design and implement secure, scalable, highly available, and resilient cloud infrastructure solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), networking, security, containers, and automation. The role involves collaborating with applications, infrastructure, security, and DevOps teams to define cloud architecture standards and support enterprise cloud transformation initiatives.
  
  

**Day to Day Job Duties:**  

* Design and implement scalable, secure, highly available, fault\-tolerant cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Define cloud architecture, infrastructure standards, patterns, and technical roadmaps.
* Design cloud networking, security, identity and access management, compute, storage, and backup solutions.
* Develop and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform or equivalent technologies.
* Architect containerized platforms using Kubernetes and Docker.
* Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
* Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience.
* Implement cloud security controls, governance, monitoring, and compliance best practices.
* Optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, and support for complex infrastructure issues.
* Review existing infrastructure and recommend modernization, automation, and optimization opportunities.


**Basic Qualifications:**  

* 8\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering and architecture, including enterprise cloud environments.
* 5\+ years of experience designing solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* 4\+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Terraform, and infrastructure automation.
* 3\+ years of experience with Kubernetes, Docker, cloud networking, and security architecture.


**Nice to Have:**  

* Experience designing multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud environments.
* Knowledge of CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with Ansible and configuration management automation.
* Strong understanding of IAM, network security, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, VPN, and private connectivity.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or cloud\-native monitoring services.
* Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization practices.
* Experience with enterprise cloud migration and application modernization programs.
* AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, or Terraform professional\-level certifications are preferred.
* Strong architecture, stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.


About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
  
  

NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. fe94e728.title: Presales Engineer – Network, Security, Collaboration, AV/VC & Wireless
fe94e728.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand customer business and technical requirements and translate them into appropriate IT infrastructure solutions.
* Design and propose solutions covering **Routing \& Switching, Enterprise Network, Security, Wireless, Collaboration and AV/VC**.
* Conduct customer meetings, technical discussions, solution presentations and product demonstrations.
* Prepare **HLD/LLD, solution architecture, BOM, BOQ, technical proposals, compliance sheets and RFP/RFQ responses**.
* Work closely with sales teams to identify opportunities and develop technical solutions aligned with customer requirements.
* Participate in **customer presentations, PoCs, technical evaluations and solution workshops**.
* Perform sizing, capacity planning and technology evaluation for proposed solutions.
* Coordinate with OEMs, distributors and technology partners for product selection, **pricing, technical validation and solution design**.
* Provide technical support during negotiations and help sales teams position the proposed solution effectively.
* Analyze existing customer infrastructure and recommend optimization, migration, upgrade and transformation solutions.
* **Ensure proposed solutions meet customer requirements**, technical standards, scalability, performance and security requirements.
* Support implementation teams during the transition from presales to project execution.

**Required Technical Expertise**

**Network – Routing \& Switching**

* Strong understanding of **Cisco Routing \& Switching, LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, VLAN, STP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, HSRP/VRRP, QoS and MPLS**.
* Experience with enterprise network architecture, core/distribution/access network and data\-center networking.
* Knowledge of Cisco Catalyst, Nexus and other enterprise networking platforms.

**Enterprise Networking**

* Enterprise LAN/WAN architecture and network segmentation.
* SD\-WAN, SDN, Data Center Networking and network automation concepts.
* Experience designing scalable and redundant network solutions.

**Network Security**

* Strong understanding of **Firewall, VPN, IPS/IDS, NAC, Zero Trust and network segmentation**.
* Presales experience with security solutions such as **Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Check Point and Cisco ISE**.
* Knowledge of security architecture and secure enterprise network design.

**Wireless**

* Enterprise Wi\-Fi architecture, WLAN design and wireless security.
* Experience with **Cisco, Aruba** or equivalent enterprise wireless solutions.
* Understanding of Wireless LAN Controller, Access Points, RF planning and guest/BYOD solutions.

**Collaboration**

* Knowledge of **Cisco Collaboration / Unified Communications, IP Telephony, Webex, CUCM, CUBE, Voice, Video Conferencing and Contact Center** solutions.
* Ability to design end\-to\-end collaboration solutions based on customer requirements.

**AV / VC**

* Knowledge of **Audio\-Visual and Video Conferencing solutions**, meeting\-room solutions, digital collaboration and integrated AV systems.
* Exposure to platforms/OEMs such as **Cisco, Poly, Logitech, Crestron, Yealink, Biamp** or equivalent is preferred.
* Understanding of room design, VC endpoints, displays, microphones, speakers and control systems.

**Presales \& Commercial Skills**

* Excellent capability in **technical solutioning and consultative selling**.
* Ability to prepare professional technical proposals and solution presentations.
* Strong **BOM/BOQ preparation and solution costing** knowledge.
* Experience responding to **RFPs, RFQs, RFI, tenders and compliance requirements**.
* Strong presentation, negotiation and customer\-facing skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical solutions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good coordination with Sales, Delivery, OEM and Procurement teams.

**Preferred Certifications**

Candidates with any of the following certifications will be preferred:

* **CCNP / CCIE**
* **Cisco Collaboration** / Wireless certifications
* **Palo Alto / Fortinet / Check Point** certifications
* **Aruba** certifications
* **AV/VC** OEM certifications

c2ec263f.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
c2ec263f.description:
**Description**
 Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
   

  

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development \& delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**Requirements**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

9876ad6c.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
   

  

**Job Details**
**Sales Arch**
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Architect serves as the embedded delivery architect supporting the assigned Salesforce delivery team. This role translates domain architecture direction, enterprise standards, and architectural guardrails into project\-level solution designs and executable delivery plans.
   

  

 The Architect maintains architecture continuity throughout the delivery lifecycle—from discovery and solution design through technical decomposition, implementation decisions, delivery assurance, and production readiness. The role partners closely with the Principal Architect, product and engineering leaders, technical leads, developers, business analysts, and other architects to ensure that solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned with the long\-term Salesforce strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Translate domain strategy, target architecture, standards, and guardrails established by the Principal Architect into project\-level solution architecture.
* Lead solution design for initiatives delivered by the assigned delivery team, including architecture diagrams, technical approaches, integration considerations, data considerations, security requirements, and non\-functional requirements.
* Decompose large architecture solutions into sequenced, workable technical deliverables with clear boundaries, dependencies, implementation approaches, and ownership.
* Work with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Engineering Leads, and Technical Leads to translate architecture into Jira epics, technical enablers, stories, and implementation milestones.
* Determine the appropriate size, sequence, and working order of technical deliverables so Technical Leads can take ownership of clearly defined implementation work.
* Maintain architecture involvement throughout implementation and close gaps between approved solution designs and the realities discovered during delivery.
* Guide in\-flight technical decisions, including configuration versus custom development, low\-code versus pro\-code approaches, integration patterns, data design, security design, and other implementation\-level choices.
* Review detailed designs and implementation outcomes to ensure alignment with architectural intent and approved standards.
* Document significant architecture decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and deviations.
* Identify architecture risks, technical debt, cross\-team dependencies, and non\-functional concerns early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Recommend remediation when implementations deviate from approved architecture or create unacceptable platform risk.
* Escalate cross\-domain decisions, material exceptions, and enterprise\-level concerns to the Principal Architect or appropriate architecture governance forum.
* Provide architecture guidance and coaching to Technical Leads, developers, and other delivery team members.
* Contribute reusable patterns, lessons learned, and delivery feedback to the Salesforce architecture community and Center of Excellence.

* Eight or more years of enterprise technology experience, including significant experience delivering solutions on the Salesforce platform.
* Demonstrated experience performing solution or delivery architecture responsibilities within complex enterprise programs.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce solution design, configuration, custom development, integration, data, security, and application lifecycle considerations.
* Experience translating high\-level architecture into executable technical work packages and delivery backlogs.
* Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions while maintaining alignment with long\-term architecture.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and with tools such as Jira.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across global, cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce architect\-level or advanced technical certifications.
* Experience supporting large\-scale, multi\-team Salesforce environments.
* Experience operating within formal architecture governance and design\-review processes.
* Experience working in regulated, highly integrated, or globally distributed enterprise environments.
