aae83644.title: SAP SD Solution Architect
aae83644.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP SD Solution Architect based in India.**
 This is a senior architecture role focused on designing and delivering scalable SAP Sales \& Distribution solutions across ECC and S/4HANA environments. You will work on development\-intensive implementation and enhancement programs where SD capabilities continuously evolve through new features, change requests, and productized improvements. The role combines deep SAP SD expertise with strong knowledge of custom development, RICEFW, integrations, and clean\-core\-aligned extensibility. You will translate complex business needs into robust technical\-functional designs and guide development teams through delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with ABAP, FI, MM, TM, EWM, and external system teams to build integrated end\-to\-end solutions. This is an opportunity to influence architecture, delivery standards, and long\-term SAP transformation initiatives within a consulting environment.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Own the solution architecture for SAP SD across development\-heavy implementation, transformation, and enhancement programs.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical\-functional designs, balancing standard SAP capabilities with appropriate custom solutions.
* Design and govern SD custom developments, including pricing logic, user exits, BADIs, enhancements, complex order processing, and output determination using technologies such as BRF\+, SmartForms, and Adobe Forms.
* Lead functional specification development and collaborate with ABAP teams on RICEFW objects, including reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows.

197ee9d0.title: Intelligent Technology Operations Technical Delivery Lead
197ee9d0.description:
Join us as a
 **Intelligent Technology Operations Technical Delivery Lead** 
 at Barclays, where you will drive strategic transformation across Technology Operations and IT Service Management—the backbone of the bank's operations responsible for maintaining service availability, reliability, resilience and operational stability. You will lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives spanning observability, AI\-enabled operations, event intelligence, SRE and automation, translating strategy into execution and ensuring measurable business outcomes through strong stakeholder alignment, delivery leadership and operational adoption.
   

  

 To be successful as
 **Intelligent Technology Operations Technical Delivery Lead,** 
 you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Enterprise Technology Transformation Delivery – leading complex, cross\-functional technology transformation programmes from strategy through execution and adoption.
* Strategic Delivery Leadership \& Navigating Ambiguity – Demonstrated ability to operate in complex and evolving environments, synthesising inputs from multiple stakeholders, delivery teams and business priorities to identify interdependencies, connect the dots, and translate ambiguity into clear, targeted and executable delivery plans.
* Technology Operations \& Engineering Practices – strong understanding of modern technology operations, including monitoring, observability, SRE, automation, event management, GenAI, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.
* Stakeholder Influence \& Communication: Strong influencing skills with the ability to align multi\-faceted stakeholders across business units and technology teams, drive outcomes without direct authority, and communicate complex multi\-stream delivery, risks, dependencies and benefits to executive audiences.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills \& Experience Include**
* GenAI, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and AIOps transformation delivery.
* Leading organisational change, talent development, and workforce transformation to build the capabilities, behaviours and operating models required to sustain adoption of strategic change in line with long\-term business outcomes.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To manage the efficient delivery of large\-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Management of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand\-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.
* Collaboration with customers and business teams to manage and implement customer trails to support the proposal of technically feasible solutions, and effort and timeline expectations.
* Collaboration with software engineers, quality teams, product managers and other engineering teams to deliver high\-quality products and features through the software project lifecycle aligned to the banks objectives, regulation and security policies.
* Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with technical projects to prepare the bank for potential challenges.
* Management of change requests and communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Management of vendor relations involved in technical projects to ensure they deliver according to agreed terms.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improving deliver outcomes and to foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence and growth.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

a15ac922.title: Senior Solution Lead, SAP IBP Cloud Solution
a15ac922.description:
The Sr. Solution lead is responsible for developing solution design and build for integrated systems within the enterprise SAP IBP Cloud solution area and corresponding set of applications. In this role the Sr. Solution lead will partner with Business Analysts and Technical Analysts to understand the overall business need, define overarching requirements and create high\-level design specifications, ensuring feasibility, functionality, and integration with existing systems/platforms and develop an overarching architectural design and model that will support Stryker’s business needs. The Sr. Solution lead is responsible for verifying the detailed technical documents, validating the configuration within the assigned applications, and ensuring solutions are delivered based on the architected design.
   

  

 The individual should be an expert with SAP IBP Cloud solution and it’s roadmap, that includes IBP Demand, Supply Planning, Response (Allocation) and other IBP Modules. And he/she must have 2\-3 full cycle implementation experience with IBP Response solutions, including Configure\-To\-Order and Make\-To\-Stock production strategies and thorough understanding/expertise in latest SAP Release with end\-to\-Order to Shipment and Business Logics (i.e. ATP rules) to support order allocation.
   

  

 Individual should be experienced with IBP Business Processes that connect IBP system with other systems and have good knowledge on various workstreams.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead the design, configuration, and deployment of SAP IBP solutions, delivering integrated end\-to\-end planning capabilities across the enterprise.
* Serve as the functional and technical subject matter expert for SAP IBP, supporting solution design, build, testing, implementation, training, and global template development.
* Drive SAP IBP initiatives across key planning areas, including S\&OP, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, IBP Time Series, MRP, and Spare Parts Planning.
* Ensure all solution delivery activities align with established Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) standards, processes, and best practices.
* Review and govern business process documentation, functional and technical specifications, test strategies, and go\-live readiness plans.
* Collaborate with global ERP teams, business stakeholders, IT partners, infrastructure teams, and deployment teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Partner with solution providers, process owners, architects, and key users to execute project deliverables and support deployment methodologies.
* Continuously optimize planning processes and system performance by identifying improvement opportunities and delivering scalable, business\-aligned solutions, including support for quarterly SAP IBP releases and enhancements.


**What you need:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree (MBA, MIS, or equivalent) preferred.
* 10\-13 years of experience delivering SAP full lifecycle implementations, with a proven track record of successful project execution.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with SAP IBP and/or SAP APO, including integration across end\-to\-end planning and supply chain processes.
* Strong expertise in SAP IBP Cloud solutions, including configuration, business process design, and integration with procurement, inventory, sales, and related functions.
* Experience integrating SAP with SAP and non\-SAP enterprise applications such as Ariba, ECC, Oracle, PRMS, MFG Pro, and other third\-party systems.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business\-focused solutions.
* Familiarity with ITIL, Agile methodologies, and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, with the ability to work across data, integration, security, and reporting domains.
* Demonstrated success collaborating within global, cross\-functional, and matrixed organizations, ideally within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industries.


 Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform

a5af2181.title: Principal Program Manager, Enterprise AI Strategy & Governance
a5af2181.description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Category** General Management **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18412 **Date posted** 08/18/2026
### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are a highly skilled program manager with strong understanding of Artificial intelligence technology and its transformative potential. With deep expertise in leading complex, cross\-functional programs, you thrive in fast\-paced environments where strategic thinking and execution go hand in hand. You are comfortable collaborating with diverse stakeholders, from engineers to executive leadership, and excel at aligning program objectives with organizational strategy.  

  

 You bring a proven track record of managing enterprise\-scale AI initiatives, including the evaluation and integration of new models, tools, and third\-party solutions. Your leadership style fosters a culture of continuous improvement, and you are adept at change management, ensuring smooth adoption of Gen/Agentic AI technologies across corporate functions. If you are energized by the challenge of shaping the future of AI at scale, Synopsys offers you the platform to make a lasting impact.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead and scale Synopsys' enterprise AI Governance operating model across GenAI, LLMs, Agentic AI, third\-party AI solutions, and internal AI applications, establishing processes for intake, evaluation, approval, monitoring, risk management, and lifecycle oversight
* Partner with Legal, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Compliance, Procurement, Engineering, Product, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate AI technologies and use cases, ensuring alignment across risk, regulatory compliance, IP protection, privacy, and security requirements
* Operationalize governance frameworks including NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), ISO/IEC 42001, and Responsible AI principles, translating them into practical workflows that balance innovation velocity with enterprise risk
* Define governance patterns for Agentic AI systems, including access controls, monitoring, auditability, and lifecycle management, partnering with R\&D teams to ensure safe and responsible deployment
* Drive AI Academy initiatives in partnership with People and business leaders to build AI literacy, responsible AI awareness, and role\-specific AI skills across the organization, developing adoption playbooks and enablement programs
* Develop governance metrics, executive dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across AI adoption and risk management
* Support strategic AI ecosystem partnerships, platform evaluations, and technology provider assessments, contributing to enterprise AI strategy, adoption roadmaps, and executive communications

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Shape how Synopsys governs, deploys, and scales AI technologies across 30,000 employees, establishing the foundation for responsible and secure AI adoption company\-wide
* Enable business units and corporate functions to adopt GenAI and Agentic AI safely and effectively, reducing risk exposure while accelerating innovation velocity
* Build governance processes that protect Synopsys' intellectual property, customer data, and regulatory compliance posture as AI becomes embedded across products and operations
* Drive workforce readiness and AI literacy across the organization, ensuring employees have the skills and awareness to integrate AI into their daily work responsibly
* Establish Synopsys as a leader in enterprise AI governance, operationalizing best practices that set the standard for responsible AI adoption in the semiconductor and high\-tech industry
* Provide executive leadership with visibility into AI adoption, risk posture, and business impact through metrics, dashboards, and reporting that inform strategic decision\-making
* Create governance mechanisms that adapt to evolving AI technologies, regulatory requirements, and business needs, ensuring Synopsys stays ahead of the curve as AI capabilities advance

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline
* 12\+ years of experience leading complex enterprise\-scale technical programs within software, semiconductor, cloud, AI, or high\-tech environments
* Experience building or operating AI Governance, Responsible AI, technology risk, compliance, cybersecurity, or enterprise transformation programs
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, AI platforms, and AI adoption challenges within large organizations
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional reviews involving Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders
* Familiarity with governance and risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging AI regulatory requirements is a plus,
* Experience with portfolio management and workflow tools such as Jira, SharePoint, Confluence etc.
* Experience driving enterprise adoption, change management, workforce enablement, or AI upskilling initiatives is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can translate complex AI governance and risk topics into clear, actionable guidance for executives, engineers, and business leaders without losing the technical nuance
* You influence across organizations and executive levels without direct authority, building trust and alignment through credibility, clarity, and follow\-through
* You operate comfortably in ambiguity, building governance structures and processes in environments where technology, policy, and business objectives are evolving in real time
* You connect the dots between AI technology capabilities, governance requirements, risk management, and business value, ensuring that governance enables rather than blocks progress
* You manage multiple high\-stakes initiatives simultaneously, keeping stakeholders aligned, timelines on track, and deliverables moving without dropping details
* You have a point of view on what good AI governance looks like and you are not afraid to push back when a policy is too vague, a process is too slow, or a risk assessment misses the actual exposure

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will be part of the Strategic Missions \& Technologies (SMT) organization, helping drive Synopsys' enterprise AI journey. The team partners closely with Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, IT, People, IP group along with executive leadership to enable the responsible, secure, and scalable adoption of AI across the company. This role reports to the Head of AI Governance, Program Management and Chief of Staff for Strategic Missions \& Technologies (SMT). This onsite role is based in Bangalore and requires regular collaboration with US\-based teams, including overlap with Pacific Time hours.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

8c991250.title: Technical Program Manager
8c991250.description:
**Program Manager – Job Description** 




  





 We are seeking an accomplished Program Manager to lead large\-scale, complex IT services programs spanning cloud, data, platform, and enterprise application landscapes. This role carries end\-to\-end ownership of program outcomes — balancing hands\-on delivery execution with strategic portfolio alignment across multiple concurrent engagements for internal stakeholders and external clients. The ideal candidate brings both program governance rigor and a
 **product engineering mindset** 
 — understanding the technical architecture underneath delivery, not just the schedule on top of it.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Program Leadership \& Delivery** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery across scope, schedule, cost, and quality — consistently meeting client satisfaction and business outcome targets.
* Establish and govern Agile/hybrid program frameworks, metrics, and tooling (Jira, executive dashboards, status reporting) across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Provide oversight across multi\-vendor, cross\-geography teams, ensuring consistent delivery standards and accountability.



**Product \& Technical Ownership** 



* Apply a product development mindset to program delivery — thinking in terms of releases, technical debt, platform scalability, and long\-term maintainability rather than just milestone dates.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to understand system design trade\-offs (cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, integration architecture) well enough to make informed scope, sequencing, and risk calls.
* Own technical roadmap alignment — ensuring program plans reflect realistic engineering constraints (CI/CD maturity, environment readiness, tech debt, dependency mapping across microservices/platforms).
* Drive quality engineering practices across programs — test automation coverage, release readiness gates, defect leakage, and production stability metrics.
* Guide build\-vs\-buy and platform modernization decisions (e.g., cloud migration, data platform re\-architecture) in collaboration with technical leadership.
* Champion DevOps and SDLC maturity — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/CloudFormation), observability, and automated deployment practices across program teams.
* Maintain working fluency in the technology stacks in play (cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP, data platforms like Snowflake/Databricks, integration/API layers) sufficient to challenge estimates, de\-risk technical dependencies, and speak credibly with client engineering teams.



**Strategic \& Portfolio Management** 



* Drive strategic planning and portfolio prioritization, aligning programs with organizational goals and client transformation roadmaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and clients, translating business objectives into executable, outcome\-driven program roadmaps.
* Shape enterprise\-scale program governance structures, risk management frameworks, and escalation mechanisms.



**Financial \& Commercial Governance** 



* Own financial governance across program budgeting, forecasting, revenue assurance, and margin optimization.
* Oversee contract execution, including SOW compliance, change management, commercial negotiations, and cross\-vendor dependencies.



**Stakeholder \& Client Management** 



* Own client communication at executive and steering committee levels — proactively managing expectations, risks, and escalations.
* Build and sustain trusted relationships with client and internal leadership, serving as the primary point of accountability for program health.



**Generative AI \& Innovation** 



* Define and drive enterprise adoption of Generative AI for program governance, predictive risk analysis, intelligent status reporting, and data\-driven decision\-making across delivery portfolios.
* Evaluate and pilot AI\-assisted engineering tools (code generation, automated testing, agentic workflows) to improve delivery velocity and quality across programs.
* Establish responsible AI usage standards within program management practices and mentor delivery teams on effective, scaled adoption.



**Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop cross\-functional and matrixed delivery teams, fostering a high\-performance, accountable delivery culture.
* Build organizational capability by coaching program and project managers on governance best practices, technical literacy, and stakeholder management.

741ac3bf.title: Pre-Sales Solution Architect – Application Development & Modernisation (AWS)
741ac3bf.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





  






 Are you passionate about designing modern application solutions on AWS?
 





 Do you enjoy partnering with customers and sales teams to shape solutions that solve real business challenges?
 





 Are you excited to combine application development, cloud, and DevSecOps in a customer\-facing role?
 




  






  
 





 You will be part of our Cloud and Application Services team, working closely with sales, delivery, and AWS specialists to design and position application transformation solutions for enterprise customers.
 





  
 





 The Pre\-Sales Solution Architect supports the design and positioning of application development solutions on AWS. This role works closely with customers, sales, and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and practical solution approaches.
 




  






 Figulus is hiring on behalf of a confidential client — a leading global technology services organisation with a fast\-growing AWS practice.
 




  






 We are looking for a Pre\-Sales Solution Architect to sit at the intersection of sales and engineering, owning the technical narrative for application development and modernisation opportunities on AWS.
 




  






 You will partner with sales teams to understand customer business problems, shape them into credible AWS architectures, and defend those designs in front of technical and executive stakeholders. This is a customer\-facing, deal\-shaping role for an architect who still enjoys getting hands\-on with code, whiteboards, and proof\-of\-concepts — not a pure documentation role.
 





 Location: Hyderabad, India. This position requires working from the office hybrid.
 




  






 Experience: 5\-8 years. Employment Type: Full\-time.
 




  






 Comfortable to work in Singapore Timezone
 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  






 Discovery \& Requirements: Partner with sales teams and customers to understand business requirements, current\-state application estates, and modernisation drivers, and translate them into clear solution concepts.
 





 Solution Design: Design scalable, secure, cost\-optimised AWS application architectures — including migration and modernisation paths, target\-state diagrams, effort estimates, and cost models for enterprise customers.
 





 Technical Engagement: Lead technical discussions, architecture workshops, product demonstrations, and proof\-of\-concept engagements with customer engineering and leadership teams.
 





 Proposals \& Bid Support: Own the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and statements of work; build and defend the architecture and pricing narrative through to deal closure.
 





 Application Development Depth: Apply hands\-on knowledge of .NET or Java, along with modern frontend frameworks, to ground architecture recommendations in delivery reality and validate feasibility.
 





 DevSecOps by Design: Embed DevSecOps practice — CI/CD pipelines, containerization, infrastructure\-as\-code, and secure development standards — into every proposed design.
 





 Documentation \& Handover: Produce high\-quality solution documentation, architecture decision records, and handover packs; run knowledge\-transfer sessions so delivery teams inherit a build\-ready design.
 





 Advisory \& Enablement: Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers and an internal enablement resource — mentoring junior architects and contributing reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and demo assets to the practice.
 





 Partner Alignment: Work with AWS partner teams on funding programmes, co\-sell motions, and joint solution positioning.
 




  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS** 




  




* Fully ramped on the client's AWS service catalogue, accelerators, and delivery model.
* Independently leading technical discovery and architecture workshops on mid\-to\-large opportunities.
* Measurable contribution to pipeline conversion through won technical evaluations and PoCs.
* At least one reusable reference architecture or demo asset contributed to the practice.



  





  




**Requirements** 

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* 5\-8 years of overall IT experience, with a minimum of 3 years in a presales, solution architecture, or customer\-facing technical consulting capacity.
* Demonstrated experience designing and presenting application solutions on AWS in a presales or pre\-contract setting.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in .NET or Java application development, plus working exposure to modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, or equivalent).
* Solid working knowledge of core AWS services across compute, storage, networking, database, and security, and of cloud\-native solution design principles.
* Practical experience with microservices and serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, Step Functions or equivalent).
* Hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tooling such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation/CDK.
* Understanding of DevSecOps practices, specifically CI/CD pipeline design and container\-based deployment models.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and credibly to audiences ranging from engineers to CIO\-level stakeholders.
* Experience building solution cost models, effort estimates, and commercial\-technical proposals.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Professional, or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer \- Professional.
* Experience with legacy application modernisation \- monolith decomposition, mainframe or .NET Framework migration, database re\-platforming.
* Exposure to a second hyperscaler (Azure or GCP) and multi\-cloud solution positioning.
* Experience working within an AWS Partner Network organisation, including Well\-Architected Framework Reviews and MAP/partner funding programmes.
* Familiarity with GenAI and agentic application patterns on AWS (Bedrock, vector stores, RAG architectures).
* Prior experience in a global systems integrator, cloud consultancy, or managed services environment.
* Observability and platform engineering exposure (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, service mesh).



  





  




**Benefits** 
* Health insurance reimbursement of up to INR 20,000 per annum.
* Company\-provided MacBook, headphones of your choice, and a company SIM.
* Lunch allowance of INR 5,000 per month.
* Hybrid working model \- 3 days in the Hyderabad office, 2 days work from home.
* High\-visibility, customer\-facing role with direct influence on deal outcomes.
* Exposure to enterprise\-scale AWS modernisation programmes across multiple industries.
* Certification sponsorship and structured cloud enablement pathways.
* Competitive compensation with performance\-linked incentives.



  






 Figulus is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

 Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation.  The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
 


* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper\-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment



  





**What this role is** 




 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. **Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**

* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions

* Implementation thinking without business context

bd86e846.title: Technical Architect
bd86e846.description:
**Overview**
 ROLE :
   

  

 We are looking for a Technical Architect with deep telecom domain expertise to design end\-to\-end technical solutions for large\-scale transformation engagements. The role sits at delivery architecture — translating client business and network requirements into scalable, secure, and cost\-effective technical designs across OSS/BSS, network functions, cloud, and integration landscapes. You will work closely with Presales, Delivery, and Client Engineering teams to shape winning proposals and ensure architectural integrity through execution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end technical architecture across core, AI/ML platform, data infrastructure, APIs, and integration layers.
* Translate product requirements (PRDs) into detailed technical designs, system diagrams, \& engineering specifications.
* Make authoritative technology choices: frameworks, cloud providers, data stores, AI/LLM orchestration tooling with


 clear rationale.
   

  

* Define and enforce engineering standards: coding guidelines, security posture, performance SLOs, and CI/CD


 practices.
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Forward Deployment Engineers \- conduct architecture and code reviews.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks early; build resilience and observability into every product layer.
* Collaborate with Product Architect on feasibility, trade\-off analysis, and build\-vs\-buy decisions.
* Drive prototype\-to\-production engineering excellence; own technical debt strategy and platform evolution roadmap.


**Architecture \& Solution Design**
* Define end\-to\-end technical architecture for telecom OSS/BSS, network automation, and digital platform engagements, covering application, integration, data, and infrastructure layers.
* Translate client RFPs/RFIs and business requirements into technical solution blueprints, high\-level and low\-level designs, and architecture decision records.
* Architect solutions spanning 4G/5G core, SD\-WAN, NFV/SDN, network orchestration, fiber/access networks, and cloud\-native telecom platforms.


**Delivery Governance**
* Provide architectural oversight through the delivery lifecycle, ensuring build teams adhere to approved designs and non\-functional requirements (scalability, security, resilience, performance).
* Conduct design reviews, technical risk assessments, and drive remediation of architecture gaps during execution.
* Mentor solution/technical leads and engineering teams on architectural best practices and emerging telecom technology trends.


**Technology \& Innovation**
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies — including cloud\-native network functions, AI/agentic automation, and observability platforms — for applicability to client engagements.
* Contribute to reusable architecture assets, reference frameworks, and accelerators for the telecom practice.


**Must\-have Skills \& Experience**
* Strong product engineering experience in one of the platforms: ServiceNow, Salesforce, Netcracker, Amdocs, Ericson.
* Expert\-level software engineering in Python, Go, or Java with strong polyglot instincts across the stack.
* Deep experience designing distributed systems, microservices, and event\-driven architectures at scale.
* Hands\-on AI/ML platform engineering: LLM integration, vector databases, RAG pipelines, model serving (vLLM,


 Ollama, TensorRT\-LLM, Triton, etc.).
   

  

* Cloud\-native expertise across AWS / Azure / GCP: Kubernetes, Terraform, observability stacks, and FinOps.
* Strong data engineering background: streaming (Kafka/Flink), warehousing (Snowflake/BigQuery), and lineage tooling.
* Security\-first mindset: zero\-trust networking, secrets management, vulnerability remediation at the infra layer.


 MINDSET \& BEHAVIOURS
   

  

* Pragmatic visionary \- balances architectural elegance with delivery speed and operational reality.


**Requirements**
 MUST\-HAVE SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE
   

  

* Strong product engineering experience in one of the platforms: ServiceNow, Salesforce, Netcracker, Amdocs, Ericson.
* Expert\-level software engineering in Python, Go, or Java with strong polyglot instincts across the stack.
* Deep experience designing distributed systems, microservices, and event\-driven architectures at scale.
* Cloud\-native expertise across AWS / Azure / GCP: Kubernetes, Terraform, observability stacks, and FinOps.
* Security\-first mindset: zero\-trust networking, secrets management, vulnerability remediation at the infra layer.
* 10\-15 years of overall IT experience with a strong track record in solution/technical architecture roles within the telecom industry.
* Hands\-on exposure to telecom domains such as OSS/BSS (order management, service assurance, billing/mediation), network functions virtualization (NFV/SDN), 4G/5G core, or SD\-WAN.
* Strong understanding of enterprise and cloud architecture patterns (AWS/Azure/GCP), microservices, API\-led integration, and containerization (Kubernetes/Docker).
* Working knowledge of TM Forum frameworks (ODA, eTOM, SID, Open APIs) is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with automation and AI/ML\-driven network operations (AIOps, agentic AI for network/service assurance) is a strong plus.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior client technology leadership.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* B.S. / M.S. in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related field.
* Published architecture patterns, open\-source contributions, or conference talks in AI/infra domain.
* Experience as a technical lead in a telecom, network automation, or enterprise SaaS environment.

 Augnito is next\-generation Voice AI for healthcare. Our cloud\-based speech recognition gives clinicians ergonomic data entry with 99% accuracy, with no voice profile training, from any device, anywhere. Built from the outset in partnership with clinicians using human\-centred design, Augnito supports a wide range of clinical vocabularies and workflows, halves clinical reporting and admin time, removes transcription delays, and helps prevent physician burnout.
 



  





 Augnito is deployed at 300\+ hospitals and health systems across 20\+ countries, including the US, UK and Canada — delivered both directly and through EMR, HIS and distribution partners.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the deployment of Augnito into enterprise hospital environments — from contract signature through go\-live, adoption and stable handover.
 



 This is a customer\-facing delivery role in a clinical setting, not a back\-office project coordination role. You will be the single accountable owner of each implementation: running the plan, holding the dates, managing hospital IT and clinical stakeholders, coordinating our Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success and Support teams, and working alongside EMR/HIS and channel partners who co\-deliver with us.
 



  





 You will have the authority to escalate, to raise change requests when scope moves, and to recommend holding a go\-live when readiness criteria are not met. We expect you to use it.
 



  





**What success looks like in the first 12 months** 




  




* Implementations land on the committed go\-live date, or the date is re\-baselined early and deliberately rather than slipping.
* Clinicians are actively using Augnito 30 and 90 days after go\-live — not just provisioned.
* Our implementation playbook, runbooks and readiness checklists are materially better than when you joined, and repeatable across geographies and partners.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Project ownership and governance** 



* Own end\-to\-end implementation projects from kick\-off through go\-live, hypercare and formal handover to Customer Success.
* Build and maintain project plans, milestone schedules, RAID logs, go\-live runbooks and readiness checklists; keep a single source of truth for every project.
* Run governance cadence with customers and internally: kick\-off, weekly working calls, steering updates, go/no\-go review, post\-implementation review.
* Manage scope actively. Where customer requests fall outside the agreed scope, raise a documented change request with effort and timeline impact rather than absorbing it silently.
* Identify, log and mitigate risks and dependencies early; escalate blockers with a recommended course of action, not just a status.
* Maintain implementation milestone status for commercial purposes, including milestones tied to invoicing and revenue recognition.



  





**Technical delivery and integration** 



* Gather clinical, business and technical requirements and translate them into an implementation plan, integration design, and test scope.
* Coordinate integration delivery with EMR, HIS, RIS and PACS systems — including HL7 v2 message flows (ADT / ORM / ORU), FHIR and REST API integrations, and embedded or in\-application deployment models.
* Coordinate endpoint and environment readiness: Windows and virtualised desktop deployment (Citrix / VDI / RDS), group policy and software distribution, mobile app rollout via MDM, SSO and directory integration (SAML / Entra ID / AD), user provisioning, network allowlisting, bandwidth and latency validation, and microphone or dictation hardware.
* Plan and manage migration from legacy dictation and transcription workflows, including existing templates, macros, auto\-texts, and custom vocabulary.
* Coordinate configuration, internal testing, customer UAT and production cutover; define entry and exit criteria for each gate.
* Validate speech accuracy and workflow fit by specialty during UAT; route accuracy gaps, vocabulary needs and product issues to the Clinical Language, Product and Engineering teams with reproducible detail.



  





**Clinical adoption and change management** 



* Plan phased rollout by department, specialty and site rather than treating go live as a single event.
* Identify and enable clinical champions and super\-users; design training for clinicians, secretarial and transcription staff, and hospital IT.
* Run go\-live support — on\-site or remote floor\-walking, early\-week check\-ins, targeted re\-training for low\-adoption cohorts.
* Own a defined hypercare period after go\-live with explicit exit criteria before handover to Customer Success and Support.



  





**Partner and channel delivery** 



* Deliver implementations jointly with EMR/HIS vendors, integration partners, system integrators and distributors — managing dependencies you do not directly control.
* Enable and quality\-assure partner\-led implementations: provide playbooks, training, readiness criteria and review gates so partners can deploy Augnito to our standard.
* Act as the delivery\-side point of contact for partner technical teams during integration build and certification.



  





**Compliance, security and privacy** 



* Run compliance and security readiness as a project workstream, not an afterthought — data protection agreements and BAAs, data residency and processing requirements, and customer security reviews.
* Coordinate responses to hospital security questionnaires and assurance frameworks with the Security and Legal teams, including HIPAA (US), UK NHS DSPT and DTAC, PIPEDA/PHIPA (Canada), the DPDP Act (India), GDPR, and ISO 27001 / SOC 2 evidence requests.
* Ensure clinical\-safety and information\-governance signoffs required by the customer are secured before go\-live.



  





**Scale and continuous improvement** 



* Improve the implementation playbook, templates, runbooks and estimation model based on what each project teaches us.
* Support pre\-sales where required: implementation scoping, effort and timeline estimation, input to statements of work, and RFP/RFI delivery sections.
* Contribute to reporting on portfolio health, delivery capacity and recurring root causes of delay.



  





**How Performance Will Be Measured** 




  




* On\-time go\-live rate against the baselined plan, and milestone adherence.
* Time\-to\-go\-live and time\-to\-first\-value from contract signature.
* Clinician adoption on day 30 and day 90 — active users and usage depth against the target user base.
* Implementation of CSAT / NPS from customer and partner stakeholders.
* Hypercare ticket volume and time to hypercare exit.
* Quality and reuse of implementation documentation and playbook assets.



  





**Required Experience and Skills** 




  




* 5–8 years of experience delivering enterprise software implementations, professional services or technical programme management, including at least 2 years in a customer\-facing delivery owner role.
* Demonstrated experience implementing software into healthcare provider environments, or equivalent regulated\-enterprise delivery experience with clear evidence you can operate in a clinical setting.
* Track record of running multiple concurrent enterprise implementations across different customers, time zones and readiness levels.
* Practical working knowledge of integration concepts: APIs, authentication, message flows, environments, and testing. You do not need to write the integration, but you must be able to challenge an estimate, read a message spec and spot a bad assumption.
* Ability to hold a professional line with senior external stakeholders — hospital CIOs, CMIOs, IT managers, clinical leads and partner delivery heads — under schedule pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; the discipline to write status that is accurate and unwelcome rather than comfortable and vague.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills; high personal organization and attention to detail.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Candidates from hospital IT, clinical informatics, radiology, health information management or clinical backgrounds who have moved into vendor\-side delivery are explicitly welcome.



  





**Preferred** 




  




* Direct experience with EMR/HIS/RIS/PACS integrations and HL7 v2 or FHIR message flows.
* Experience deploying to virtualised desktop environments (Citrix, VDI, RDS) and managing endpoint software rollout at scale.
* Experience with speech recognition, clinical documentation, transcription, or medical coding workflows.
* Experience delivering through channel partners, distributors, or system integrators.
* Exposure to healthcare privacy and security regimes (HIPAA, NHS DSPT/DTAC, GDPR, DPDP Act) and to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 environments.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
* Tooling: Jira / Asana / ClickUp, Smartsheet or MS Project, Postman, basic SQL, advanced Excel or Sheets, Salesforce / HubSpot / Zoho.



  





**Working Model and Practicalities** 




  




* Portfolio: typically, 4–6 concurrent implementations of varying size and complexity.
* Geographies: customers across India, the Middle East, UK, and others. Expect regular working overlaps with Middle East and UK time zones.
* Travel: This role will require travel to customer sites (domestically and/or internationally) for go\-lives and key customer or partner milestones.
* Reports to the Sr Director, Client Solutions. As the implementation function grows, this role is the intended path to leading the team.



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




  





 Our technology works. The difference between a hospital that pilots Augnito and a hospital that runs on Augnito is almost entirely implementation — integration quality, clinician trust, and someone competent holding the whole thing together. That is this job.

**Location: Bangalore**

**About the Role** 




 The Global Program Manager for Query Fabric / Fabric as a Service (FaaS) is responsible for leading the program delivery of unified query execution platform — enabling enterprises to run analytical workloads across heterogeneous compute environments and data sources through a single, governed fabric. This is a technically complex, ecosystem\-facing program that requires close coordination with engineering, cloud partners, enterprise architects, and field technical teams. The GPM owns the program structure that ensures FaaS capabilities are delivered with interoperability, enterprise readiness, and GTM alignment as first\-class outcomes.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the Fabric as a Service program plan — defining delivery milestones across query engine integrations, connector development, governance layers, and cloud deployment targets.
* Drive alignment across engineering, platform architecture, cloud partnerships, and product management on FaaS scope, sequencing, and launch criteria.
* Manage the dependency surface between Query Fabric and other platform programs — including Elastic Compute, ADP, and Context Engine — ensuring workstreams are coordinated and blockers are resolved without downstream impact.
* Define and track enterprise readiness criteria for FaaS: security, compliance, performance SLAs, observability, and support coverage — ensuring each capability meets the bar before customer exposure.
* Partner with cloud and ecosystem alliance teams to manage external partner dependencies, integration timelines, and co\-launch coordination.
* Lead technical enablement readiness — ensuring that sales engineers, solution architects, and customer\-facing technical teams can position, configure, and support FaaS effectively at launch.
* Own program health reporting for FaaS leadership reviews, tracking delivery confidence, integration status, risk exposure, and partner readiness.
* Facilitate feedback loops between early adopter customers, field teams, and product engineering — translating real\-world configuration and performance signals into prioritized backlog input.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* FaaS capabilities launch with demonstrated interoperability across target compute environments, with clear documentation, validated performance benchmarks, and full technical enablement coverage.
* Cross\-program dependencies are managed proactively — engineering teams operate with clear interfaces and handoffs, and FaaS delivery does not create drag on adjacent platform programs.
* Cloud and ecosystem partners are engaged, aligned on timelines, and ready to co\-deliver or co\-market at launch.
* Field and customer\-facing technical teams are equipped to configure and support FaaS from day one, reducing time\-to\-value for early customers.



  





**Who You'll Work With** 




 This role requires deep engagement with platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, and solutions architecture on the build side, and with sales engineering, technical enablement, customer success, and cloud alliance teams on the deployment and adoption side. You will represent FaaS program status to senior leadership and navigate external partner relationships at a program level.
 



  





**Non\-Negotiable Qualifications** 



* 10\+ years of program management experience in the tech industry, with at least 5 years leading cross\-functional, global programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing technically complex platform or infrastructure programs — ideally with cloud, data, or query/compute infrastructure components.
* Ability to engage credibly with engineers and architects on technical scope and integration design, while simultaneously managing GTM and enablement workstreams.
* Strong dependency management skills — experience mapping and managing large, multi\-team delivery programs with external partner components.
* Effective communicator across engineering, field, and executive audiences.
* Bachelor's degree required.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with federated query engines, data virtualization, cloud data platforms, or multi\-cloud architecture programs.
* Familiarity with ecosystem partner management and co\-sell or co\-launch motions with cloud providers.
* PMP or equivalent certification; agile delivery experience in a large engineering organization.
* Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline.

76b7598e.title: Product Solution Engineer
76b7598e.description:
**Product Solution Engineer** 




  





**Why is this important?** 




 Digital is growing exponentially. In just a few years, the billion people in India will be connected and consuming products and services digitally. This transformation is not only moving payments to digital form, it is opening doors to new kinds of businesses and consumer behavior that is transforming the finance industry.
 



 Internet \& mobile ecosystems are transforming commerce. While usage of credit instruments is growing steadily, the penetration of users purchasing with credit today is just 75 million. There are 400 million Indians with a private credit bureau score. Yet almost 300\+ million don't own a credit instrument or credit\-line to shop online.
 



 At Juspay, the Credit Platform team builds products that make purchases affordable and/or help customers seek credit to better finance outcomes, whether for consumers completing a transaction, or for suppliers and distributors working with a brand / manufacturer or an e\-commerce marketplace.
 



 We are hiring people who care about solving problems fundamentally as merchant success team members who will closely work with our customer’s product managers and developers and ensure their success. It is a mix of engineering understanding, product understanding and above all customer empathy.
 



  





**What does it take?** 



1. Drive the integration of Merchants and help to understand the problem and its cause by digging deep into data, logs, code and engaging with relevant stakeholders.
2. Imagine how the experience for customers \& merchants needs to be and constantly work on making it happen. Enhance ways of merchant self\-service and work towards faster onboarding.
3. Liaison with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to onboard the merchant and establish trust with the merchants by doing the right thing.
4. Be the doctor who doesn’t just hear symptoms from patients and give medicine for that but also pro\-actively helps to prevent any future diseases
5. Be technically hands\-on while resolving issues and develop a deep understanding of all our products



  





**What will I do?** 



1. Take ownership of merchant issues and requests through to resolution
2. Research, diagnose and troubleshoot issues by following SLAs
3. Guide non\-technical users through the issue resolution process
4. Product integration support for merchants
5. Collect and document information about users problems for future references
6. Follow standard procedures for proper escalation of unresolved issues to the appropriate internal teams
7. Provide prompt and accurate feedback to merchants
8. Document knowledge in the form of knowledge base tech notes and articles
9. Collaborate with team for application enhancements requirements



 10\. Data analysis, transaction reconciliations and investigation of disputed
 



 transactions
 



  





**Must have qualities** 




 1\. Aspiration for quality and bringing out what is expected
 



 2\. Genuine user empathy
 



 3\. Clear solutioning mindset by thinking from the customer's shoes
 



 4\. Strong problem solving skills
 



 5\. Extreme responsiveness to solve problems
 



 6\. Curiosity to understand how things work
 



 7\. Openness and patience to learn harder things
 



 8\. Attitude and ability to get\-things\-done and never let it go
 



 9\. Effectively balance big picture/details
 



 10\.Self\-motivated and driven
 



 11\.Persuasive without being forceful
 



 12\.Strong communication and interpersonal skills with people management skills
 



  





**Qualifications preferred** 




 ● Engineering with 2\-4 years of experience.
 



 ● Experience or eagerness to work in a highly charged start\-up environment
 



 ● A “keep going at it” and a “never say no” attitude towards problem solving
 



 ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to non\-technical users
 



 ● Ability to work as an individual as well as collaborate across teams
 



 ● Decent programming skills and basic knowledge of how tech works!
 



 ● Proficiency in SQL is a plus
 



 ● Any design/wireframing tool experience would be an advantage
 



  





**About the company** 




 Juspay's vision is to enable frictionless transactions for billions. The payments landscape in India, compared to the rest of the world, has been evolving at a much faster pace. It is unique in terms of being mobile\-first, mandating 2FA, next\-gen networks like UPI, merging online\-offline, being hardware\-less and so on. However, these advances bring along unreliable systems \& mandates to meet high\-security standards which increase friction for users.
 



 Juspay, with its zero\-one products \& next\-gen proprietary technology, is uniquely positioned to solve the end\-end payments problem in India and also expand internationally. We are extremely technology and product\-focused and have achieved exponential growth in an organic revenue\-driven way.
 



 Incidentally, our tech/design innovation was recognized and we helped the Government of India develop the BHIM app, which has set the gold standard for UPI interfaces \& even got international awards for its design.

dffb53f6.description:
Job Description
**Job Description**


**Engagement Manager (US Region)\- HYD based**  

  

  



**About Darwinbox**


Darwinboxis Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.

  

Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.

  

Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.  

  

  



**Why Join Us?**


The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:


* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper\-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment
  

**What this role is**


Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.


**Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**

  

This role sits at the intersection of:


* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery
* You will act as:


* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones

  

**What the work looks like**


* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.


* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.


* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.


* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

  

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.


That means:


* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
* Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.

  

**Who thrives here**


* People who think in systems.


* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.


* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

  

**What we explicitly don’t optimize for**


* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

  

**What we’re looking for**


* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving

  

**What We Offer:**


* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

04db233d.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
04db233d.description:
**Job Description**
 Lead Technical Program Manager would be responsible for the transition, delivery governance, and execution oversight of WSP Digital Products. The role would coordinate product onboarding, roadmap execution, cross\-functional delivery planning, release readiness, operational readiness, and leadership reporting to ensure products move from MVP/transition state into stable, governed, and sustainable WSP\-owned operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Product Transition \& Portfolio Governance**
* Lead transition planning and execution for current and future digital products entering the portfolio
* Create and maintain product transition roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency trackers, risk registers, and readiness checklists.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer, documentation readiness, operational handover, and ownership transition from partner or vendor teams.
* Establish a repeatable product onboarding approach for upcoming products in the pipeline.


**Program Delivery \& Execution Management**
* Drive cross\-functional planning across product, architecture, development, QA, DevOps, data, release, and support teams.
* Track delivery progress, scope, milestones, dependencies, RAID items, decisions, and action owners.
* Support sprint, release, transition, and stabilization planning across multiple product workstreams.
* Ensure delivery execution is aligned to product priorities, business outcomes, technical readiness, and operational constraints.


**Stakeholder Management \& Leadership Reporting**
* Act as the primary coordination point between product owners, business stakeholders, engineering leads, architects, support teams, and leadership.
* Prepare concise leadership updates covering accomplishments, risks, blockers, decisions required, and upcoming milestones.
* Facilitate governance forums, steering reviews, transition checkpoints, and escalation discussions.
* Translate technical delivery status into clear business impact and decision\-support information.


**Operational Readiness \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure release readiness, support readiness, documentation readiness, monitoring readiness, and product handover closure.
* Support definition of product operating model, support model, escalation path, SLA/SLO expectations, and operational KPIs.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks, process gaps, transition risks, and improvement opportunities across product operations.
* Contribute to SOPs, governance playbooks, transition templates, and product operating standards.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Technical Program Management \| Advanced — transition planning, roadmap tracking, milestone management, RAID governance, and cross\-functional execution
* Product Delivery Governance \| Advanced — product onboarding, ownership transition, release readiness, operational readiness, and decision tracking
* Agile / Product Delivery \| Proficient — backlog awareness, sprint/release planning support, delivery tracking, and dependency management
* Stakeholder Communication \| Advanced — leadership reporting, steering reviews, escalation management, and business/technology translation
* Cloud / SaaS Awareness \| Proficient — enterprise digital products, integrations, DevOps, QA, support models, and SaaS operating considerations
* Risk \& Dependency Management \| Advanced — risk mitigation, assumption tracking, dependency resolution, and governance\-based delivery control.


**Required Experience**
* Minimum 10 years of professional experience in technical program management, delivery management, product operations, or enterprise software delivery.
* Experience leading product transition, product onboarding, vendor\-to\-internal\-team handover, or MVP\-to\-production stabilization programs.
* Proven ability to coordinate delivery across product, architecture, engineering, DevOps, QA, data, business, and support teams.
* Experience preparing senior leadership reports, steering committee updates, RAID logs, decision logs, and transition status packs.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps ways of working, release governance, and enterprise product operating models.


**Preferred (Not Required)**
* Experience working with enterprise SaaS, cloud\-hosted products, digital platforms, or integration\-heavy applications.
* Experience in engineering, environmental, consulting, infrastructure, or professional\-services technology domains.
* Exposure to CAB, ITIL change/release governance, service transition, SOP creation, and operational readiness processes.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI, or similar delivery governance tools.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* PMP, SAFe, Scrum Master, Agile, or ITIL certification is preferred but not mandatory.


 BGV

We design lasting solutions in the Transportation \& Infrastructure, Property \& Buildings, Earth \& Environment, Power \& Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. * A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.


***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***

 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

 With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
   

  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.


**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
 Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.

We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.

**With us, you can.
