 We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
   

  

**We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.**
 Join AHEAD's Rapid Solutions Team as a Rapid Solutions Pod Lead, a role that spans engagement leadership, people leadership, client delivery, and offering development. You will be the primary point of accountability for every engagement in your pod, from the first client conversation through the executive readout, owning scope, governance, cadence, and outcomes. You will also lead a small pod of engineers, setting their goals and coaching their growth, so the team behind each engagement is as strong as the engagement itself. Beyond delivery, you will own the evolution of the Rapid Solutions offering, refining the playbooks, templates, and delivery standards that keep the practice repeatable and scalable.
   

  

 This role sits within AHEAD's AI \& Cloud Practice, so engagements center on helping clients modernize and optimize across multi\-cloud platforms, platform engineering, and AI\-driven solutions. You'll bring that focus to bear on every Rapid Assess and Rapid Solutions engagement your pod delivers.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
**5\+** 
 years of relevant experience in:
   

  

 Engagement Leadership
   

  

* Own every engagement end to end as Engagement Lead, from kickoff through executive readout, serving as the primary customer point of contact and the single point of accountability for delivery.
* Own scope and SoW compliance: set success criteria, manage change control, and keep stakeholders aligned on outcomes and boundaries.
* Run governance and cadence: standups, status reporting, stakeholder and steering reviews, RAID management, and decision logs.
* Act as the escalation point for engagement risk, resolving issues before they threaten scope, timeline, or the client relationship.
* Drive quality control through peer reviews and readiness checks on all client\-facing deliverables.


 People Leadership
   

  

* Lead a 2\-3 person pod, planning and executing work across discovery, analysis, and executive readout, and ensuring each engagement has the right people staffed against it.
* Set quarterly and annual goals for pod members and provide structured coaching and feedback to support their growth.
* Staff and manage utilization across sold and internal projects, forecasting needs and maintaining delivery rhythm.
* Maintain engagement hygiene: risks, decisions, and artifact version control.


 Solution Delivery
   

  

* Drive technical discovery and analysis across multi\-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), platform engineering, identity, networking, security, and app/data domains.
* Produce prioritized recommendations with effort sizing and a sequenced roadmap.
* Translate findings into executive\-ready narratives tied to business outcomes.


 Standards, Tooling \& Reuse
   

  

* Implement AI\-driven solutions to reduce toil and accelerate insight.
* Capture and evolve collateral (questionnaires, scoring rubrics, readout templates) and fold it into the Rapid Solutions playbook for consistent delivery.


 Practice Development \& Offering Evolution
   

  

* Define and refine Rapid Solutions offerings: own the playbook, templates, and delivery standards, removing ambiguity and ensuring repeatability.
* Partner with practice leaders to align Rapid Solutions standards with broader AHEAD delivery frameworks and cross\-practice initiatives.


**Why AHEAD**
 Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
   

  

 We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.
   

  

**India Employment Benefits Include**
**Comprehensive health insurance** 
 coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
   

  

**Paid time off and company holidays** 
 , along with additional leave benefits as per policy
   

  

**Flexible work arrangements** 
 , supporting work\-life balance
   

  

**Learning and development opportunities** 
 to support continuous growth and upskilling
   

  

**Employee wellness initiatives** 
 and programs focused on physical and mental well\-being
   

  

**Retirement and statutory benefits** 
 in line with India regulations
   

  

**Inclusive and people\-first culture** 
 , with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

a36a2af1.title: Senior Configuration and Delivery Manager
a36a2af1.description:
**Job Description**
 Configuration and Delivery Manager would be responsible for configuration control, release coordination, deployment governance, and delivery readiness across current and upcoming WSP Digital Products. The role would ensure that product configuration, environment readiness, version control, release packages, deployment approvals, and production releases are managed through controlled, traceable, auditable, and repeatable processes across development, test, staging, and production environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Configuration Management**
 Define and maintain configuration management standards across applications, environments, release packages, and deployment artefacts.
   

  

 Maintain traceability for product versions, configuration items, environment variables, dependencies, release baselines, and deployment records.
   

  

 Coordinate configuration changes across application, integration, data, infrastructure, and environment layers.
   

  

 Ensure configuration decisions are documented, controlled, and auditable.
   

  

**Release \& Deployment Management**
 Plan, coordinate, schedule, and govern product releases across current and upcoming digital products.
   

  

 Maintain release calendars, deployment schedules, release notes, release scope, deployment checklist, and rollback plans.
   

  

 Coordinate release readiness reviews, QA sign\-offs, DevOps readiness, CAB inputs, and production deployment approvals.
   

  

 Track release risks, deployment issues, defects, rollback outcomes, and post\-release validation status.
   

  

**Environment \& Delivery Readiness**
 Coordinate environment readiness across Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production, and support environments.
   

  

 Ensure environment consistency, access readiness, dependency readiness, and deployment sequencing before release execution.
   

  

 Support environment refresh, configuration updates, smoke\-test coordination, and deployment troubleshooting.
   

  

 Work with DevOps and engineering teams to improve repeatability and reliability of deployment practices.
   

  

**Compliance, Metrics \& Continuous Improvemen** 
 t
   

  

 Maintain release evidence, approval records, deployment logs, release decisions, and audit\-ready documentation.
   

  

 Track release metrics including deployment frequency, failed deployments, rollback frequency, defect leakage, and release predictability.
   

  

 Identify recurring release and configuration issues and drive preventive improvements with engineering, QA, DevOps, and support teams.
   

  

 Contribute to release SOPs, configuration playbooks, governance checklists, and operational documentation.
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
**Configuration Management \|** 
 Advanced — software baselines, version control, configuration item traceability, environment configuration, and audit records
   

  

**Release Management \|** 
 Advanced — release planning, deployment coordination, CAB inputs, release readiness, rollback planning, and sign\-offs
   

  

**DevOps / CI\-CD Awareness \|** 
 Proficient — Azure DevOps, GitHub, branching, tagging, pipelines, deployment controls, and release artefacts
   

  

**Environment Governance \|** 
 Proficient — Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production readiness, environment refresh, and deployment sequencing
   

  

**ITIL / Change Governance \|** 
 Proficient — change, release, configuration, risk\-based approvals, governance documentation, and auditability
   

  

**Stakeholder Coordination \|** 
 Advanced — coordination across engineering, QA, DevOps, business, support, and leadership teams
   

  

**Required Experience**
 Minimum 8 years of professional experience in configuration management, release management, DevOps coordination, IT operations, or software delivery governance.
   

  

 Experience managing enterprise release cycles across multiple environments and product teams.
   

  

 Experience with configuration baselines, release packages, deployment records, change controls, and audit\-ready documentation.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Git, branching strategies, build/release pipelines, and deployment governance.
   

  

 Experience coordinating CAB approvals, release readiness, rollback planning, deployment validation, and post\-release verification.
   

  

**Preferred (Not Required)**
 Experience supporting SaaS, cloud\-hosted, or integration\-heavy enterprise digital products.
   

  

 Exposure to ITIL Change, Release, and Configuration Management practices.
   

  

 Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Confluence, or similar tools.
   

  

 Exposure to product transition, MVP stabilization, or multi\-vendor delivery models.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* ITIL Foundation, DevOps, Agile, or Release Management certification is preferred but not mandatory.

c9852673.title: Technical Program Manager
c9852673.description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
 



  





 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 A senior techno\-functional role sitting between business and engineering. You'll embed with business teams, translate their pain into buildable solutions, and drive them to production with Engineering Architects and Developers. Above all, this is a transformation role — you will change how teams and departments work and deliver measurable business impact across the firm. This is an AI\-first role: Claude Chat, Cowork, and Code are core to how you discover, document, prototype, and deliver.
 



  





**The Role at a Glance** 



* **Own outcomes** 
 across multiple business domains and drive firm\-level impact.
* **Set the agenda** 
 for requirements, prioritization, and build\-vs\-buy decisions.
* **Partner** 
 with Engineering Architects and Developers from design through production.
* **Set the AI standard** 
 and mentor juniors to lift the wider team.



  





**What You'll Do \& the Impact You'll Own** 




**Measured by outcomes, not activity. Within 12–18 months:** 



* **Drive transformation:** 
 Act as change agent across teams and departments; land measurable business impact and lift internal NPS / stakeholder satisfaction by 20\+ points.
* **Discover \& re\-engineer processes:** 
 Embed with business teams, map current/target\-state flows (BPMN), and cut cycle time 30–50% on 2–3 core workflows through re\-engineering, automation, and AI.
* **Translate to delivery artifacts:** 
 Convert workflows into user stories, story points, acceptance criteria, and BRDs precise enough for engineers to build without rework.
* **Partner on solutions:** 
 Shape design with Engineering Architects and Developers; stay engaged through build, test, and release.
* **Deliver AI\-first:** 
 Use Claude Chat, Cowork, and Code daily; drive 80%\+ active adoption and 25%\+ productivity gains across your domains.
* **Own roadmap \& build\-vs\-buy:** 
 Prioritize multi\-quarter plans; run POCs and present data\-driven build\-vs\-buy recommendations; unlock 1–2 firm\-level initiatives with measurable revenue or CX impact.
* **Deliver value \& reduce risk:** 
 Lead Agile execution and stakeholder buy\-in; deliver $500K–$2M\+ annual savings/avoidance and cut incidents, audit findings, and control gaps by 40%\+.
* **Lead \& mentor:** 
 Guide junior consultants (including as direct reports); raise delivery quality and win senior sponsorship.



  





**What You'll Need** 



* **Experience:** 
 10–15\+ years overall; 5–8\+ in Solutioning, product/project management, or technical consulting with a discovery\-to\-production track record.
* **Technical bar (screening filter):** 
 Write SQL, read APIs, interpret architecture diagrams, and critically direct AI coding tools like Claude Code. Non\-technical analysts are not a fit.
* **AI\-first delivery:** 
 Daily hands\-on with Claude Chat, Cowork, Code (or equivalents); able to set AI delivery standards for a team.
* **Transformation mindset:** 
 Proven track record of cross\-functional change that materially altered how teams work — measurable impact, not just delivered projects.
* **Technical foundation:** 
 Strong SQL, APIs, data modeling; solid grasp of SDLC, cloud (AWS/Azure), and modern architecture. Prior developer experience strongly preferred.
* **Delivery craft:** 
 Hands\-on process mapping, user stories, and acceptance criteria; extensive Agile/Scrum and Jira/Confluence experience across concurrent workstreams.
* **Leadership \& communication:** 
 Develop juniors, influence without authority, and write proposals that win senior buy\-in across business, technical, and executive audiences.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's required; Master's in Management, Technology, or related preferred. Prior consulting or vertical\-industry background a plus.
